FILE: face-trajectory/cpp/include/face_trajectory/shared_json.hpp
SHA256: 1eadbb26fde03c1b03d4ac222d115b2dc4b78ac0f957cedf8057c099c4a0d5e6
================================================================================
L000001: #pragma once
L000002: #include "face_trajectory/state.hpp"
L000003: #include <nlohmann/json.hpp>
L000004: #include <algorithm>
L000005: #include <map>
L000006: #include <set>
L000007: #include <stdexcept>
L000008: #include <string>
L000009: #include <vector>
L000010: 
L000011: namespace face_trajectory {
L000012: // Immutable AVL sequences. Versions share unchanged subtrees, including nested
L000013: // arrays. Evidence uses observation IDs as keys, so arbitrary IDs insert locally
L000014: // rather than shifting every subsequent leaf. All other arrays use ordinal keys.
L000015: // The cache lives for one operation; no reference can survive a transaction rollback.
L000016: class SharedJson {
L000017:     using J = nlohmann::json;
L000018:     State& state_;
L000019:     std::map<std::string,J> cache_;
L000020:     std::map<std::string,J> values_;
L000021:     J Node(const std::string& ref) {
L000022:         if(ref.empty()) return {{"h",0}};
L000023:         auto found=cache_.find(ref);
L000024:         if(found!=cache_.end()) return found->second;
L000025:         auto text=state_.Get("object",ref);
L000026:         if(!text) throw std::runtime_error("missing shared trajectory node");
L000027:         auto node=J::parse(*text);
L000028:         if(node.contains("value_ref")) {
L000029:             const auto value_ref=node.at("value_ref").get<std::string>();
L000030:             const auto found=values_.find(value_ref);
L000031:             if(found!=values_.end()) node["v"]=found->second;
L000032:             else {
L000033:                 const auto value=state_.Get("object",value_ref);
L000034:                 if(!value) throw std::runtime_error("missing shared trajectory value");
L000035:                 node["v"]=J::parse(*value); values_.emplace(value_ref,node.at("v"));
L000036:             }
L000037:             node.erase("value_ref");
L000038:         }
L000039:         cache_.emplace(ref,node); return node;
L000040:     }
L000041:     int Height(const std::string& ref) { return Node(ref).at("h"); }
L000042:     std::string Make(const std::string& key,const J& value,const std::string& left,const std::string& right) {
L000043:         J node={{"k",key},{"v",value},{"l",left},{"r",right},{"h",1+std::max(Height(left),Height(right))}};
L000044:         auto stored=node;
L000045:         // A path copy references an evidence body once, instead of copying that
L000046:         // body's fields at every ancestor/version. Small scalar values stay inline.
L000047:         if(value.is_object() || value.is_array()) {
L000048:             const auto ref=state_.Intern(value.dump()); values_.emplace(ref,value);
L000049:             stored.erase("v"); stored["value_ref"]=ref;
L000050:         }
L000051:         const auto ref=state_.Intern(stored.dump()); cache_.emplace(ref,std::move(node)); return ref;
L000052:     }
L000053:     std::string Balance(const std::string& key,const J& value,std::string left,std::string right) {
L000054:         if(Height(left)>Height(right)+1) {
L000055:             auto a=Node(left);
L000056:             if(Height(a.at("r"))>Height(a.at("l"))) {
L000057:                 const auto b=Node(a.at("r"));
L000058:                 left=Make(b.at("k"),b.at("v"),Make(a.at("k"),a.at("v"),a.at("l"),b.at("l")),b.at("r"));
L000059:                 a=Node(left);
L000060:             }
L000061:             return Make(a.at("k"),a.at("v"),a.at("l"),Make(key,value,a.at("r"),right));
L000062:         }
L000063:         if(Height(right)>Height(left)+1) {
L000064:             auto a=Node(right);
L000065:             if(Height(a.at("l"))>Height(a.at("r"))) {
L000066:                 const auto b=Node(a.at("l"));
L000067:                 right=Make(b.at("k"),b.at("v"),b.at("l"),Make(a.at("k"),a.at("v"),b.at("r"),a.at("r")));
L000068:                 a=Node(right);
L000069:             }
L000070:             return Make(a.at("k"),a.at("v"),Make(key,value,left,a.at("l")),a.at("r"));
L000071:         }
L000072:         return Make(key,value,left,right);
L000073:     }
L000074:     std::string Put(const std::string& ref,const std::string& key,const J& value) {
L000075:         if(ref.empty()) return Make(key,value,"","");
L000076:         const auto node=Node(ref); const auto oldkey=node.at("k").get<std::string>();
L000077:         if(key==oldkey) return Make(key,value,node.at("l"),node.at("r"));
L000078:         if(key<oldkey) return Balance(oldkey,node.at("v"),Put(node.at("l"),key,value),node.at("r"));
L000079:         return Balance(oldkey,node.at("v"),node.at("l"),Put(node.at("r"),key,value));
L000080:     }
L000081:     std::optional<J> Find(std::string ref,const std::string& key) {
L000082:         while(!ref.empty()) { const auto node=Node(ref); const auto k=node.at("k").get<std::string>();
L000083:             if(key==k) return node.at("v"); ref=node.at(key<k?"l":"r").get<std::string>(); }
L000084:         return {};
L000085:     }
L000086:     std::string Erase(const std::string& ref,const std::string& key) {
L000087:         if(ref.empty()) return ref;
L000088:         const auto node=Node(ref); const auto k=node.at("k").get<std::string>();
L000089:         if(key<k) return Balance(k,node.at("v"),Erase(node.at("l"),key),node.at("r"));
L000090:         if(key>k) return Balance(k,node.at("v"),node.at("l"),Erase(node.at("r"),key));
L000091:         if(node.at("l")=="") return node.at("r");
L000092:         if(node.at("r")=="") return node.at("l");
L000093:         auto successor=Node(node.at("r"));
L000094:         while(successor.at("l")!="") successor=Node(successor.at("l"));
L000095:         return Balance(successor.at("k"),successor.at("v"),node.at("l"),Erase(node.at("r"),successor.at("k")));
L000096:     }
L000097:     void Keys(const std::string& ref,std::set<std::string>& keys) {
L000098:         if(ref.empty()) return;
L000099:         const auto node=Node(ref); keys.insert(node.at("k")); Keys(node.at("l"),keys); Keys(node.at("r"),keys);
L000100:     }
L000101:     std::string Build(const std::vector<std::pair<std::string,J>>& items,std::size_t lo,std::size_t hi) {
L000102:         if(lo==hi) return "";
L000103:         const auto mid=lo+(hi-lo)/2;
L000104:         return Make(items[mid].first,items[mid].second,Build(items,lo,mid),Build(items,mid+1,hi));
L000105:     }
L000106:     void Values(const std::string& ref,J& values) {
L000107:         if(ref.empty()) return;
L000108:         const auto node=Node(ref); Values(node.at("l"),values); values.push_back(Decode(node.at("v"))); Values(node.at("r"),values);
L000109:     }
L000110:     static std::string Ordinal(std::size_t index) {
L000111:         auto key=std::to_string(index); return std::string(20-key.size(),'0')+key;
L000112:     }
L000113: public:
L000114:     explicit SharedJson(State& state):state_(state) {}
L000115:     J Encode(const J& value,bool evidence=false,const std::optional<J>& previous={}) {
L000116:         if(value.is_array()) {
L000117:             if(previous && previous->is_object() && previous->contains("$avl") && previous->at("keyed")==evidence) {
L000118:                 auto root=previous->at("$avl").get<std::string>();
L000119:                 std::set<std::string> removed; Keys(root,removed);
L000120:                 for(std::size_t i=0;i<value.size();++i) {
L000121:                     const auto key=evidence?value[i].at("observation_id").get<std::string>():Ordinal(i);
L000122:                     const auto old=Find(root,key); const auto encoded=Encode(value[i],false,old);
L000123:                     if(!old || *old!=encoded) root=Put(root,key,encoded);
L000124:                     removed.erase(key);
L000125:                 }
L000126:                 for(const auto& key:removed) root=Erase(root,key);
L000127:                 return {{"$avl",root},{"count",value.size()},{"keyed",evidence}};
L000128:             }
L000129:             std::vector<std::pair<std::string,J>> items; items.reserve(value.size());
L000130:             for(std::size_t i=0;i<value.size();++i)
L000131:                 items.emplace_back(evidence?value[i].at("observation_id").get<std::string>():Ordinal(i),Encode(value[i]));
L000132:             if(evidence) std::sort(items.begin(),items.end(),[](const auto& a,const auto& b){return a.first<b.first;});
L000133:             return {{"$avl",Build(items,0,items.size())},{"count",items.size()},{"keyed",evidence}};
L000134:         }
L000135:         if(value.is_object()) { J result=J::object();
L000136:             for(auto it=value.begin();it!=value.end();++it) result[it.key()]=Encode(it.value(),it.key()=="evidence",
L000137:                 previous && previous->is_object() && previous->contains(it.key())?std::optional<J>(previous->at(it.key())):std::nullopt);
L000138:             return result;
L000139:         }
L000140:         return value;
L000141:     }
L000142:     J Decode(const J& value) {
L000143:         if(value.is_object() && value.contains("$avl")) {
L000144:             J result=J::array(); Values(value.at("$avl"),result);
L000145:             if(result.size()!=Count(value)) throw std::runtime_error("shared trajectory sequence count mismatch");
L000146:             return result;
L000147:         }
L000148:         if(value.is_object()) { J result=J::object(); for(auto it=value.begin();it!=value.end();++it) result[it.key()]=Decode(it.value()); return result; }
L000149:         return value;
L000150:     }
L000151:     static std::size_t Count(const J& sequence) { return sequence.at("count").get<std::size_t>(); }
L000152:     J At(const J& sequence,std::size_t index) {
L000153:         if(sequence.at("keyed").get<bool>() || index>=Count(sequence)) throw std::out_of_range("shared sequence index");
L000154:         const auto value=Find(sequence.at("$avl"),Ordinal(index));
L000155:         if(!value) throw std::runtime_error("missing shared sequence entry"); return *value;
L000156:     }
L000157:     void Set(J& sequence,std::size_t index,const J& encoded) {
L000158:         if(sequence.at("keyed").get<bool>() || index>Count(sequence)) throw std::out_of_range("shared sequence index");
L000159:         sequence["$avl"]=Put(sequence.at("$avl"),Ordinal(index),encoded);
L000160:         if(index==Count(sequence)) sequence["count"]=index+1;
L000161:     }
L000162:     void Append(J& sequence,const J& value) { Set(sequence,Count(sequence),Encode(value)); }
L000163:     void InsertEvidence(J& sequence,const J& evidence) {
L000164:         const auto key=evidence.at("observation_id").get<std::string>();
L000165:         if(!sequence.at("keyed").get<bool>() || Find(sequence.at("$avl"),key)) throw std::logic_error("append proof reused an existing observation");
L000166:         sequence["$avl"]=Put(sequence.at("$avl"),key,Encode(evidence)); sequence["count"]=Count(sequence)+1;
L000167:     }
L000168: };
L000169: }

L000067: AssociationPolicy CheckedPolicy(AssociationPolicy p) {
L000068:     const auto unit = [](double v) { return std::isfinite(v) && v >= 0 && v <= 1; };
L000069:     if (p.policy_id.empty() || !unit(p.new_target_threshold) || !unit(p.match_threshold) ||

L000071:         p.template_update_threshold < p.match_threshold || !unit(p.max_template_similarity) ||

L000074:         !std::isfinite(p.min_face_size_px) || p.min_face_size_px <= 0 ||
L000075:         p.max_clock_uncertainty_ms < 0 || p.max_templates_per_target == 0) {

L000244: CameraCompatibility AssociationStore::Compatible(const FaceObservation& o, const std::string& target,
L000245:                                                   const AssociationPolicy& policy, const CameraGraph& graph) const {
L000246:     if (state_) {
L000247:         const auto summary = EnsureTargetIndex(target);
L000248:         if (summary.camera_counts.empty()) return CameraCompatibility::Compatible;
L000249:         if (summary.camera_counts.size()==1 && summary.camera_counts.begin()->first==o.camera_id) {
L000250:             bool conflict=false;
L000251:             state_->Scan("association_frame",[&](const auto&,const auto& text){
L000252:                 const auto track=nlohmann::json::parse(text);
L000253:                 if (o.local_track_id.empty() || track.at(1).get<std::string>().empty() ||
L000254:                     track.at(0)!=o.track_session_id || track.at(1)!=o.local_track_id) conflict=true;
L000255:             },{},false,FrameIndexKey(target,o));
L000256:             // CheckCaptureChain makes exactly this same-camera conclusion,
L000257:             // after applying the original same-source/frame collision rule.
L000258:             return conflict ? CameraCompatibility::Conflict : CameraCompatibility::Compatible;
L000259:         }
L000260:     }
L000261:     const auto history = TargetMetadata(target);
L000262:     if (history.empty()) return CameraCompatibility::Compatible;
L000263:     std::vector<CaptureInterval> captures{{o.camera_id,Lower(o),Upper(o)}};
L000264:     for (const auto& old : history) {
L000265:         if (o.camera_id == old.camera_id) {
L000266:             // Two different face observations in one source frame cannot be one person.
L000267:             if (o.source_id == old.source_id && o.frame_id == old.frame_id &&
L000268:                 (o.local_track_id.empty() || old.local_track_id.empty() || Track(o) != Track(old))) {
L000269:                 return CameraCompatibility::Conflict;
L000270:             }
L000271:         }
L000272:         captures.push_back({old.camera_id,Lower(old),Upper(old)});
L000273:     }
L000274:     switch (CheckCaptureChain(std::move(captures),graph,policy.overlapping_cameras,policy.topology_is_complete)) {
L000275:         case ChainFeasibility::Feasible: return CameraCompatibility::Compatible;
L000276:         case ChainFeasibility::Infeasible: return CameraCompatibility::Conflict;
L000277:         default:return CameraCompatibility::Unknown;
L000278:     }
L000279: }

L000341: AssociationResult AssociationStore::Observe(FaceObservation observation, const AssociationPolicy& input_policy,
L000342:                                             const CameraGraph& input_graph, bool reconsider) {

L000355:         throw std::invalid_argument("association policy changed without a new policy_id");

L000365:     std::optional<std::uint64_t> append_previous_target_revision;

L000367:     // after camera filtering. The gallery also validates the contract and vector.
L000368:     Gallery::ValidateQuery(o.feature_space,o.embedding);

L000376:     result.graph_version = graph.version;
L000377:     const auto& current = next.observation;

L000379:         result.decision = "UNASSIGNED";
L000380:         result.reason = "capture time is not qualified UTC evidence";
L000381:     } else if (!UsableFace(current, policy)) {
L000382:         result.decision = "UNASSIGNED";
L000383:         result.reason = "face does not pass configured detection and size gates";
L000384:     } else {
L000385:         std::vector<AssociationCandidate> eligible;
L000386:         for (const auto& hit : hits) {

L000388:             // leaders are known and the visual Top8 has been classified.
L000389:             if (result.candidates.size()>=8 && eligible.size()>=2) break;
L000390:             if (result.candidates.size()>=8 && eligible.empty() && hit.similarity<policy.new_target_threshold) break;
L000391:             if(result.candidates.size()>=8 && eligible.size()==1 &&
L000392:                 (eligible[0].hit.similarity<policy.match_threshold ||
L000393:                  eligible[0].hit.similarity-hit.similarity>=policy.min_margin)) {
L000394:                 result.remaining_similarity_upper_bound=hit.similarity;
L000395:                 break;
L000396:             }
L000397:             const auto compatibility = Compatible(current, hit.person_entity_id, policy, graph);
L000398:             AssociationCandidate candidate{hit, compatibility};

L000400:             if (compatibility != CameraCompatibility::Conflict)
L000401:                 eligible.push_back(candidate);
L000402:         }
L000403:         // Keep the visual Top8 and the decision's feasible winner/runner-up.
L000404:         for (std::size_t i = 0; i < std::min<std::size_t>(2, eligible.size()); ++i) {
L000405:             if (std::none_of(result.candidates.begin(), result.candidates.end(), [&](const auto& c) {
L000406:                     return c.hit.person_entity_id == eligible[i].hit.person_entity_id;
L000407:                 })) result.candidates.push_back(eligible[i]);
L000408:         }

L000413:                     if (count) track_targets.insert(target);
L000414:             } else {
L000415:             const auto track = track_observations_.find(Track(current));
L000416:             if (track != track_observations_.end()) {
L000417:                 for (const auto& id : track->second) track_targets.insert(*records_.at(id).result.target_id);
L000418:             }
L000419:             }
L000420:         }
L000421:         if (!eligible.empty() && eligible[0].hit.similarity >= policy.match_threshold &&
L000422:             (eligible.size() == 1 || eligible[0].hit.similarity - eligible[1].hit.similarity >= policy.min_margin)) {
L000423:             const auto& best = eligible[0];

L000429:                 result.reason = "joint capture feasibility could not be established from topology or within solve budget";
L000430:             } else {
L000431:                 result.decision = "MATCHED";
L000432:                 result.reason = "face margin and available camera constraints passed";
L000433:                 if (!previous) append_previous_target_revision=TargetRevision(best.hit.person_entity_id);
L000434:                 Assign(next, best.hit.person_entity_id, "association:" + current.observation_id, policy,
L000435:                        best.hit.similarity >= policy.template_update_threshold &&
L000436:                        best.hit.similarity < policy.max_template_similarity);
L000437:             }
L000438:         } else if (hits.empty() || hits[0].similarity < policy.new_target_threshold) {
L000439:             if (!track_targets.empty()) {
L000440:                 result.decision = "CONFLICT";
L000441:                 result.reason = "local track face no longer supports its accepted identity";
L000442:             } else {
L000443:                 result.decision = "CREATED";
L000444:                 result.reason = "no similar identity in the compatible feature space";

L000446:                     state_?state_->Scope():std::string{},current.source_id,current.observation_id}).dump());

L000448:                 Assign(next, target, "association:" + current.observation_id, policy, true);
L000449:             }
L000450:         } else {
L000451:             const bool conflict = eligible.empty() || eligible[0].hit.similarity < policy.new_target_threshold;
L000452:             result.decision = conflict ? "CONFLICT" : "PROVISIONAL";
L000453:             result.reason = conflict ? "similar faces conflict with camera evidence"
L000454:                                              : "face score or person margin is inconclusive";
L000455:         }
L000456:     }
L000457:     result.version = ++version_;
L000458:     const bool new_policy=policies_.emplace(policy.policy_id, policy).second;
L000459:     const bool new_graph=graphs_.emplace(graph.version, graph).second;
L000460:     if(state_){if(new_policy)state_->Put("policy",policy.policy_id,nlohmann::json(policy).dump());if(new_graph)state_->Put("association_graph",graph.version,nlohmann::json(graph).dump());}
L000461:     const auto id = current.observation_id;
L000462:     const bool append = !previous && append_previous_target_revision && result.sighting && result.target_id &&
L000463:         result.affected_target_ids.size()==1 && result.affected_target_ids.front()==*result.target_id;
L000464:     SaveRecord(next);
L000465:     if (append) last_append_=AssociationAppend{*result.sighting,*append_previous_target_revision,TargetRevision(*result.target_id)};

L000467: }

L000469: AssociationResult AssociationStore::Correct(const std::string& observation_id, const std::string& target,
L000470:                                             const std::string& evidence) {
L000471:     last_append_.reset();
L000472:     if (target.empty() || evidence.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("target and correction evidence are required");
L000473:     auto loaded=LoadRecord(observation_id);
L000474:     if(!loaded)throw std::out_of_range("observation not found");
L000475:     auto& record=*loaded;
L000476:     const auto& policy = policies_.at(record.result.policy_id);
L000477:     if (!UsableTime(record.observation, policy) || !UsableFace(record.observation, policy))
L000478:         throw std::invalid_argument("correction cannot manufacture qualified face/capture evidence");
L000479:     if (record.result.sighting && record.result.target_id == target &&
L000480:         record.result.sighting->attribution_evidence_id == evidence) return record.result;
L000481:     record.result.affected_target_ids.clear();
L000482:     record.result.template_added = false;
L000483:     if (record.result.target_id) ForgetTemplate(observation_id, *record.result.target_id);
L000484:     Assign(record, target, evidence, policy, true);
L000485:     record.result.decision = "CORRECTED";
L000486:     record.result.reason = "external verified attribution correction";
L000487:     record.result.version = ++version_;
L000488:     SaveRecord(record);
L000489:     return record.result;
L000490: }

L000502: std::uint64_t AssociationStore::TargetRevision(const std::string& target) const {
L000503:     if (state_) {
L000504:         const auto revision = state_->Get("association_target_revision", target);
L000505:         if (revision) return std::stoull(*revision);
L000506:         // Old databases have targets but no per-target binding. A stable legacy
L000507:         // generation requires one rebuild, without invalidating unrelated targets.
L000508:         return state_->Get("association_target", target) ? 1 : 0;
L000509:     }
L000510:     const auto found = target_revisions_.find(target);
L000511:     return found == target_revisions_.end() ? 0 : found->second;

L000051: // Proleptic Gregorian civil date to days since 1970-01-01. No host timezone or
L000052: // time_t dependency; years before 1970 keep their signed millisecond value.
L000053: Millis Days(int year, unsigned month, unsigned day) {
L000054:     year -= month <= 2;
L000055:     const auto era = year / 400;
L000056:     const auto yoe = static_cast<unsigned>(year - era * 400);
L000057:     const auto shifted_month = month > 2 ? month - 3 : month + 9;
L000058:     const auto doy = (153 * shifted_month + 2) / 5 + day - 1;
L000059:     const auto doe = yoe * 365 + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100 + doy;
L000060:     return static_cast<Millis>(era) * 146097 + doe - 719468;
L000061: }
L000062: struct ParsedTime { Millis utc_ms; Millis resolution_ms; Millis timezone_offset_minutes; std::string timezone_source; };
L000063: ParsedTime Parse(const std::string& text, const json& profile) {
L000064:     if (text.size() < 19 || text.size() > 32 || text[4] != '-' || text[7] != '-' ||
L000065:         (text[10] != 'T' && text[10] != ' ') || text[13] != ':' || text[16] != ':')
L000066:         throw std::invalid_argument("expected ISO8601 timestamp with seconds");
L000067:     auto digits = [&](std::size_t index, std::size_t count) {
L000068:         int result = 0;
L000069:         if (index + count > text.size()) throw std::invalid_argument("truncated capture time");
L000070:         for (std::size_t i = index; i < index + count; ++i) {
L000071:             if (text[i] < '0' || text[i] > '9') throw std::invalid_argument("invalid capture time digit");
L000072:             result = result * 10 + text[i] - '0';
L000073:         }
L000074:         return result;
L000075:     };
L000076:     const auto year = digits(0, 4), month = digits(5, 2), day = digits(8, 2);
L000077:     const auto hour = digits(11, 2), minute = digits(14, 2), second = digits(17, 2);
L000078:     const bool leap = year % 4 == 0 && (year % 100 != 0 || year % 400 == 0);
L000079:     const int month_days[] = {31, leap ? 29 : 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31};
L000080:     if (year < 1 || month < 1 || month > 12 || day < 1 || day > month_days[month - 1] ||
L000081:         hour > 23 || minute > 59 || second > 59)
L000082:         throw std::invalid_argument("invalid Gregorian capture date or time");
L000083:     std::size_t cursor = 19;
L000084:     Millis fraction = 0, resolution = 1000;
L000085:     if (cursor < text.size() && text[cursor] == '.') {
L000086:         const auto start = ++cursor;
L000087:         while (cursor < text.size() && text[cursor] >= '0' && text[cursor] <= '9') ++cursor;
L000088:         const auto count = cursor - start;
L000089:         if (count < 1 || count > 3) throw std::invalid_argument("capture fraction must have 1 to 3 digits");
L000090:         fraction = digits(start, count);
L000091:         resolution = count == 1 ? 100 : count == 2 ? 10 : 1;
L000092:         fraction *= resolution;
L000093:     }
L000094:     Millis offset_minutes = 0;
L000095:     std::string timezone_source = "EXPLICIT_TIMESTAMP_OFFSET";
L000096:     if (cursor == text.size()) {
L000097:         if (!profile.contains("fixed_utc_offset_minutes")) throw std::invalid_argument("naive capture time requires configured fixed UTC offset");
L000098:         offset_minutes = FixedOffset(profile);
L000099:         timezone_source = "PROFILE_FIXED_OFFSET";
L000100:     } else if (text[cursor] == 'Z' && cursor + 1 == text.size()) {
L000101:         offset_minutes = 0;
L000102:     } else {
L000103:         if ((text[cursor] != '+' && text[cursor] != '-') || cursor + 6 != text.size() || text[cursor + 3] != ':')
L000104:             throw std::invalid_argument("invalid timestamp UTC offset");
L000105:         const auto oh = digits(cursor + 1, 2), om = digits(cursor + 4, 2);
L000106:         if (om > 59 || oh > 14 || (oh == 14 && om != 0) ||
L000107:             (text[cursor] == '-' && oh == 0 && om == 0))
L000108:             throw std::invalid_argument("invalid or unknown timestamp UTC offset");
L000109:         offset_minutes = (oh * 60 + om) * (text[cursor] == '-' ? -1 : 1);
L000110:     }
L000111:     return {Days(year, month, day) * 86400000 + hour * 3600000LL + minute * 60000LL +
L000112:                 second * 1000LL + fraction - offset_minutes * 60000,
L000113:             resolution, offset_minutes, timezone_source};
L000114: }

L000120: void ClockAdapter::Put(const json& profile) {

L000162: json ClockAdapter::Normalize(const json& request) const {

L000164:     const auto raw = Required(request, "raw_time");
L000165:     const auto policy = request.value("time_policy", std::string("CORRECTED_UTC"));

L000195:     std::size_t nominal_matches = 0;

L000200:             const auto first = Integer(calibration, "valid_from_utc_ms"), last = Integer(calibration, "valid_until_utc_ms");
L000201:             if (candidate < first || candidate >= last) continue;

L000204:                                    std::max(Integer(calibration, "time_resolution_ms"), parsed.resolution_ms) - 1);

L000206:             selected = calibration;
L000207:             corrected = candidate;
L000208:             uncertainty = error;
L000209:         } catch (const std::invalid_argument&) { overflow = true; }
L000210:     }
L000211:     if (nominal_matches > 1) return Hold("AMBIGUOUS_CLOCK_CALIBRATION", provenance);
L000212:     if (selected.is_null()) {
L000213:         if (overflow) return Hold("CLOCK_ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW", provenance);
L000214:         return Hold(boundary ? "CALIBRATION_BOUNDARY_UNCERTAIN" : "OUTSIDE_CALIBRATION_VALIDITY", provenance);
L000215:     }

L000217:     provenance["calibration_source_evidence_id"] = selected.at("source_evidence_id");

L000219:     provenance["calibration_uncertainty_ms"] = selected.at("uncertainty_ms");
L000220:     provenance["configured_time_resolution_ms"] = selected.at("time_resolution_ms");
L000221:     provenance["valid_from_utc_ms"] = selected.at("valid_from_utc_ms");
L000222:     provenance["valid_until_utc_ms"] = selected.at("valid_until_utc_ms");
L000223:     const auto offset = Integer(selected, "offset_ms");
L000224:     provenance["applied_offset_ms"] = offset;
L000225:     if (policy == "CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S") {
L000226:         provenance["applied_offset_ms"] = 0;
L000227:         // The calibration selects a verified true-time window, but the emitted
L000228:         // nominal time stays on the camera clock. Include the entire offset,
L000229:         // measurement/drift uncertainty and quantization in its error bound.
L000230:         // Check before abs/add so INT64_MIN and large errors cannot overflow.
L000231:         if (offset < -CameraCaptureErrorLimitMs || offset > CameraCaptureErrorLimitMs)
L000232:             return Hold("CAMERA_CLOCK_ERROR_EXCEEDS_60S", provenance);
L000233:         const auto magnitude = offset < 0 ? -offset : offset;
L000234:         if (uncertainty > CameraCaptureErrorLimitMs - magnitude)
L000235:             return Hold("CAMERA_CLOCK_ERROR_EXCEEDS_60S", provenance);
L000236:         uncertainty += magnitude;
L000237:         corrected = parsed.utc_ms;
L000238:         provenance["device_time_error_bound_ms"] = uncertainty;
L000239:     }

L000241:             {"captured_at_unix_ms", corrected}, {"clock_uncertainty_ms", uncertainty},
L000242:             {"time_source", "UTC_CAPTURE"}, {"clock_domain", "UTC"}, {"provenance", provenance}};

L000049: void Normalize(Embedding& value) {
L000050:     double squared_norm = 0;
L000051:     for (float component : value) {
L000052:         if (!std::isfinite(component)) {
L000053:             throw std::invalid_argument("embedding must contain finite values");
L000054:         }
L000055:         squared_norm += static_cast<double>(component) * component;
L000056:     }
L000057:     if (!(squared_norm > 0) || !std::isfinite(squared_norm)) {
L000058:         throw std::invalid_argument("embedding must have nonzero finite norm");
L000059:     }
L000060:     const double inverse_norm = 1.0 / std::sqrt(squared_norm);
L000061:     for (float& component : value) {
L000062:         component = static_cast<float>(component * inverse_norm);
L000063:     }
L000064: }
L000065: 
L000066: float Dot(const Embedding& left, const Embedding& right) {
L000067: #if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__SSE2__)
L000068:     // Float inputs, double products/accumulation. Do not lower precision near
L000069:     // identity thresholds to obtain a faster benchmark.
L000070:     __m128d a=_mm_setzero_pd(),b=a;
L000071:     for(std::size_t i=0;i<kEmbeddingDim;i+=4){
L000072:         const auto l=_mm_loadu_ps(left.data()+i),r=_mm_loadu_ps(right.data()+i);
L000073:         a=_mm_add_pd(a,_mm_mul_pd(_mm_cvtps_pd(l),_mm_cvtps_pd(r)));
L000074:         b=_mm_add_pd(b,_mm_mul_pd(_mm_cvtps_pd(_mm_movehl_ps(l,l)),_mm_cvtps_pd(_mm_movehl_ps(r,r))));
L000075:     }
L000076:     double lanes[2];_mm_storeu_pd(lanes,_mm_add_pd(a,b));
L000077:     return static_cast<float>(lanes[0]+lanes[1]);
L000078: #else
L000079:     double sum = 0;
L000080:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kEmbeddingDim; ++i) {
L000081:         sum += static_cast<double>(left[i]) * right[i];
L000082:     }
L000083:     return static_cast<float>(sum);
L000084: #endif
L000085: }

L000175: std::vector<PersonHit> Gallery::Search(
L000176:     const FeatureSpaceContract& feature_space, const Embedding& query, std::size_t top_k) const {
L000177:     const auto normalized_space = CanonicalizeSpace(feature_space);
L000178:     if (top_k == 0) throw std::invalid_argument("positive top_k is required");
L000179:     Embedding normalized_query = query;
L000180:     Normalize(normalized_query);
L000181:     std::shared_lock lock(mutex_);
L000182:     std::vector<PersonHit> hits;
L000183:     const auto bucket = templates_by_space_.find(normalized_space);
L000184:     if (bucket != templates_by_space_.end()) {
L000185:         const auto& rows=bucket->second.rows;
L000186:         std::vector<float> scores(rows.size());
L000187: #ifdef _OPENMP
L000188:         const int threads=std::max(1,std::min(8,omp_get_num_procs()));
L000189: #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) num_threads(threads) if(rows.size()>=10000)
L000190: #endif
L000191:         for(std::int64_t i=0;i<static_cast<std::int64_t>(rows.size());++i)
L000192:             scores[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)]=Dot(normalized_query,rows[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)].embedding);
L000193:         std::vector<std::optional<std::size_t>> best(bucket->second.persons.size());
L000194:         for (std::size_t slot=0;slot<rows.size();++slot) {
L000195:             const auto& value=rows[slot];
L000196:             const auto& id=value.template_id;
L000197:             const float score = scores[slot];
L000198:             auto& winner=best[value.person_slot];
L000199:             if (!winner || score > scores[*winner] ||
L000200:                 (score == scores[*winner] && id < rows[*winner].template_id)) {
L000201:                 winner=slot;
L000202:             }
L000203:         }
L000204:         hits.reserve(bucket->second.person_slots.size());
L000205:         for(std::size_t i=0;i<best.size();++i)if(best[i])
L000206:             hits.push_back({bucket->second.persons[i].id,rows[*best[i]].template_id,scores[*best[i]]});
L000207:     }
L000208:     const auto better = [](const PersonHit& a, const PersonHit& b) {
L000209:         if (a.similarity != b.similarity) return a.similarity > b.similarity;
L000210:         return a.person_entity_id < b.person_entity_id;
L000211:     };
L000212:     if (hits.size() > top_k) {
L000213:         std::nth_element(hits.begin(), hits.begin() + top_k, hits.end(), better);
L000214:         hits.resize(top_k);
L000215:     }
L000216:     std::sort(hits.begin(), hits.end(), better);
L000217:     return hits;
L000218: }

L000056:                 auto& line=r["polyline"];
L000057:                 const auto& points=e.at("points");
L000058:                 if(!line.empty() && Distance(line.back(),points.front())>model.at("join_tolerance").get<double>())r["status"]="DISCONTINUOUS_GEOMETRY";
L000059:                 for(const auto& p:points)line.push_back(p);
L000060:                 r["edges"].push_back({{"edge_id",path.edge_ids[i]},{"points",points},
L000061:                     {"earliest_unix_ms",path.edge_time_bounds.at(i).earliest_unix_ms},
L000062:                     {"latest_unix_ms",path.edge_time_bounds.at(i).latest_unix_ms}});
L000063:             }
L000064:             if(r["status"]!="AVAILABLE_INFERRED")r["polyline"]=json::array();
L000065:             entry["routes"].push_back(std::move(r));
L000066:         };
L000067:         if(segment.primary)route(*segment.primary,0);
L000068:         for(std::size_t i=0;i<segment.backups.size();++i)route(segment.backups[i],i+1);
L000069:         entry["status"]=segment.primary?"INFERRED":"UNKNOWN";
L000070:         result["segments"].push_back(std::move(entry));
L000071:     }
L000072:     return result;
L000073: }

L000268: json MonitoringStore::Get(const std::string& target, const AssociationStore& associations,std::optional<std::int64_t> before) const {
L000269:     RequireDurable();

L000274:     for(const auto& sighting:sightings) {
L000275:         const auto managed=state_->Get("monitoring_observation",sighting.observation_id);
L000276:         if(!managed) continue; // Legacy bare UTC assertions cannot activate this clock-qualified intake.
L000277:         const auto rec=ObservationRecord(state_,*managed,false);
L000278:         if(!rec.at("response").value("time_admitted",false)) continue;
L000279:         const auto face_bounds=Bounds(sighting.captured_at_unix_ms,sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms);

L000282:             const auto gate=json::parse(text);
L000283:             if(gate.at("normalization").value("status","")!="NORMALIZED") { ignored.push_back(id); return; }
L000284:             if(!seen_gates.insert(id).second) return;
L000285:             const auto& n=gate.at("normalization");
L000286:             const auto bounds=Bounds(n.at("captured_at_unix_ms"),n.at("clock_uncertainty_ms"));
L000287:             events.push_back({"gate:"+id,gate.at("payload").at("direction"),bounds.first,bounds.second,
L000288:                 {{"event_id",id},{"observation_id",sighting.observation_id},{"binding_evidence_id",gate.at("binding").at("evidence_id")}}});
L000289:             // An explicit identity link does not erase an independently timed
L000290:             // face sighting. Only overlapping intervals can represent the same
L000291:             // passage evidence without fabricating an extra inside observation.
L000292:             represented_by_gate |= bounds.first<=face_bounds.second && face_bounds.first<=bounds.second;
L000293:         },{},false,sighting.observation_id);
L000294:         if(!represented_by_gate) {
L000295:             events.push_back({"face:"+sighting.observation_id,"SIGHTING",face_bounds.first,face_bounds.second,
L000296:                 {{"observation_id",sighting.observation_id},{"camera_id",sighting.camera_id}}});
L000297:         }
L000298:     }
L000299:     // Identity already established for this gate passage remains evidence of
L000300:     // its own still-valid event. An expired face reference is not replayed.

L000302:         const auto gate=json::parse(text);
L000303:         if(!gate.value("binding_history_pruned",false)||!gate.at("binding").is_null()||seen_gates.count(id)||gate.value("bound_target_id",std::string{})!=target||gate.at("normalization").value("status","")!="NORMALIZED")return;

L000316:     }

L000362: void MonitoringStore::CheckpointRuntime(std::int64_t cutoff,const AssociationStore& associations) {
L000363:     std::set<std::string> targets;
L000364:     state_->Scan("association_target",[&](const auto& id,const auto&){targets.insert(id);});
L000365:     state_->Scan("monitoring_runtime",[&](const auto& id,const auto&){targets.insert(id);});
L000366:     for(const auto& target:targets) {
L000367:         const auto complete=Get(target,associations);
L000368:         auto p=Get(target,associations,cutoff);
L000369:         auto dependencies=json::array();
L000370:         for(const auto& group:complete.at("event_groups")) {
L000371:             bool old_positive=group.value("pruned_positive",false),old_exit=group.value("pruned_exit",false);
L000372:             for(const auto& event:group.at("events")) {
L000373:                 const auto lower=event.at("earliest_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>(),upper=event.at("latest_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
L000374:                 if(lower+(upper-lower)/2<cutoff){old_exit|=event.at("kind")=="EXIT";old_positive|=event.at("kind")!="EXIT";}
L000375:             }
L000376:             if(!old_positive&&!old_exit)continue;
L000377:             for(const auto& event:group.at("events")) {
L000378:                 const auto lower=event.at("earliest_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>(),upper=event.at("latest_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
L000379:                 if(lower+(upper-lower)/2>=cutoff)dependencies.push_back({{"event_hash",ActivityStore::Digest(event.at("event_id").get<std::string>())},{"pruned_positive",old_positive},{"pruned_exit",old_exit}});
L000380:             }
L000381:         }
L000382:         if(p.at("status")=="NOT_STARTED"&&dependencies.empty())continue;
L000383:         json seed={{"status",p.at("status")},{"entry_status","UNKNOWN"},{"session_id",nullptr},{"boundary_ambiguous",false}};
L000384:         seed["boundary_dependencies"]=dependencies;
L000385:         if(!p.at("sessions").empty()){const auto& s=p.at("sessions").back();seed["session_id"]=s.at("session_id");seed["entry_status"]=s.at("entry_status");seed["boundary_ambiguous"]=s.at("boundary_ambiguous");}
L000386:         // No historical time, camera, event key or passage sequence survives.
L000387:         state_->Put("monitoring_runtime",target,seed.dump());
L000388:     }
L000389: }

L000297: json One(const std::string& configured,std::int64_t now,bool dry_run,const ClockAdapter& clocks,const ExpiredReference& external) {
L000298:     const auto path=std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(std::filesystem::absolute(std::filesystem::u8path(configured)));
L000299:     json result={{"path",path.u8string()},{"dry_run",dry_run},{"status","ERROR"}};
L000300:     if(!std::filesystem::is_regular_file(path)){result["reason"]="CONFIGURED_P1_FILE_MISSING";return result;}
L000301:     // Read-only inventory never creates a lease file or a tombstone table.
L000302:     std::unique_ptr<Lease> owner,lease;
L000303:     std::unique_ptr<PauseRequest> pause;

L000305:         owner=std::make_unique<Lease>(path,".maintenance.lock");
L000306:         if(!owner->held){result["status"]="BLOCKED_OTHER_MAINTENANCE";return result;}
L000307:         pause=std::make_unique<PauseRequest>(path);
L000308:         const auto deadline=std::chrono::steady_clock::now()+std::chrono::seconds(20);
L000309:         do {
L000310:             lease=std::make_unique<Lease>(path);
L000311:             if(lease->held)break;
L000312:             lease.reset();std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(50));
L000313:         } while(std::chrono::steady_clock::now()<deadline);

L000315:         result["pause_handshake"]="QUIESCENT";

L000317:     }
L000318:     Database database(path.u8string(),dry_run);auto db=database.db;
L000319:     if(!dry_run)Sql(db,"PRAGMA secure_delete=ON");
L000320:     Sql(db,dry_run?"BEGIN":"BEGIN IMMEDIATE");
L000321:     try {
L000322:         result["before"]=Stats(db,path);

L000324:         std::set<std::string> expired_keys;
L000325:         for(const auto& row:rows)if(row.expired&&(row.table=="deliveries"||row.table=="outbox"))expired_keys.insert(row.key);
L000326:         std::uint64_t expired=0,known=0,unknown=0,enrolled=0,retained=0;
L000327:         for(const auto& row:rows) {

L000330:             const auto field=row.enrolled?"excluded_enrollment_rows":!row.expired?"retained_rows":row.known?"expired_known_rows":"expired_unknown_rows";
L000331:             stats[field]=stats.at(field).get<std::uint64_t>()+1;
L000332:             if(row.enrolled)++enrolled;else if(!row.expired)++retained;else {++expired;if(row.known)++known;else ++unknown;}
L000333:         }
L000334:         result["tables"]=tables;result["expired_rows"]=expired;result["expired_known_rows"]=known;
L000335:         result["expired_unknown_rows"]=unknown;result["retained_window_rows"]=retained;result["excluded_enrollment_rows"]=enrolled;
L000336:         result["unknown_policy"]="IMMEDIATE_EXPIRY_WITH_HASH_TOMBSTONE_NO_NEW_WINDOW";
L000337:         std::uint64_t dependencies=0;
L000338:         for(auto& row:rows)if(!row.expired&&!row.enrolled&&row.data.is_object()) {
L000339:             auto expired_reference=[&](const std::string& activity,const std::string& source,const std::string& event){return HasExpired(db,expired_keys,external,activity,source,event);};
L000340:             if(!ScrubReferences(row.data,ContextString(row.data,"activity_id",{}),ContextString(row.data,"source_id",{}),expired_reference))continue;

L000344:                 // Preserve the original content hash for identical retry/conflict.
L000345:                 // A changed pending body cannot be resent under the original ID.
L000346:                 const auto status=Columns(db,row.table).count("status")?",status=CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN 'QUARANTINED' ELSE status END":"";
L000347:                 Statement update(db,"UPDATE "+row.table+" SET "+column+"=?"+status+" WHERE id=?");
L000348:                 update.Bind(1,row.data.dump());update.Bind(2,row.key);update.Step();

L000350:         }

L000356:                 tombstone.Bind(1,row.table);tombstone.Bind(2,ActivityStore::Digest(row.key));tombstone.Bind(3,row.hash);tombstone.Step();
L000357:                 Statement erase(db,"DELETE FROM "+row.table+" WHERE id=?");erase.Bind(1,row.key);erase.Step();
L000358:             }
L000359:             // Receipts are historical transaction snapshots. Canonical current
L000360:             // state is queried from P2; retaining an old receipt can retain points
L000361:             // from before this delivery's own capture. Enrollment is excluded.
L000362:             std::uint64_t scrubbed=0;
L000363:             for(const auto* table:{"deliveries","outbox"}) {
L000364:                 auto columns=Columns(db,table);if(!columns.count("receipt"))continue;
L000365:                 const auto predicate=columns.count("route")?" AND route<>'/v1/monitoring/persons'":"";
L000366:                 Sql(db,std::string("UPDATE ")+table+" SET receipt=NULL WHERE receipt IS NOT NULL"+predicate);
L000367:                 scrubbed+=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sqlite3_changes(db));
L000368:             }
L000369:             // A processed capture report may refer to a deleted observation or
L000370:             // contain a legacy embedded result. Images and metadata in the valid
L000371:             // capture window remain intact; current results come from P2.
L000372:             auto columns=Columns(db,"captures");
L000373:             if(columns.count("result")) {
L000374:                 const auto predicate=columns.count("status")?"status='PROCESSED' AND ":"";
L000375:                 Sql(db,std::string("UPDATE captures SET result=NULL WHERE ")+predicate+"result IS NOT NULL");
L000376:                 scrubbed+=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sqlite3_changes(db));
L000377:             }
L000378:             result["scrubbed_historical_receipts"]=scrubbed;
L000379:             result["tombstones"]=Scalar(db,"SELECT count(*) FROM retention_tombstone");
L000380:         }
L000381:         // Once committing starts, any later error must leave P1 paused until
L000382:         // another run verifies both physical cleanup and marker removal.
L000383:         if(!dry_run)pause->keep=true;
L000384:         Sql(db,"COMMIT");
L000385:         if(!dry_run) {
L000386:             result["after_logical"]=Stats(db,path);
L000387:             // A crash after commit must remain paused until another maintenance
L000388:             // run completes the physical sweep; stale pages may still exist.
L000389:             pause->Set("PHYSICAL_CLEANUP_PENDING");
L000390:             // secure_delete only zeros pages freed by this connection. Earlier
L000391:             // image/result updates may have freed pages before it was enabled.
L000392:             // VACUUM rebuilds only reachable rows and removes those old bytes.
L000393:             bool compacted=true;
L000394:             try {Sql(db,"VACUUM");result["vacuum_status"]="COMPLETE";}
L000395:             catch(const std::exception& error){compacted=false;result["vacuum_status"]="PENDING_READERS_OR_WRITER";result["vacuum_error"]=error.what();}
L000396:             int log=0,checkpointed=0;const auto checkpoint=sqlite3_wal_checkpoint_v2(db,nullptr,SQLITE_CHECKPOINT_TRUNCATE,&log,&checkpointed);
L000397:             result["checkpoint_status"]=checkpoint==SQLITE_OK?"COMPLETE":"PENDING_READERS";
L000398:             result["checkpoint_log_frames"]=log;result["checkpointed_frames"]=checkpointed;
L000399:             result["status"]=checkpoint==SQLITE_OK&&compacted?"CLEANED":"PHYSICAL_CLEANUP_PENDING";
L000400:         } else result["status"]="DRY_RUN";
L000401:         result["after"]=Stats(db,path);
L000402:         if(!dry_run&&result.at("status")=="CLEANED") {
L000403:             // Do not report COMPLETE while an ignored DeleteFile failure can
L000404:             // still keep the Python runtime paused. Both leases remain held.
L000405:             pause->Complete();result["maintenance_request_status"]="CLEARED";
L000406:         }
L000407:         return result;
L000408:     } catch(...) {sqlite3_exec(db,"ROLLBACK",nullptr,nullptr,nullptr);throw;}
L000409: }

L000411: json PruneP1(const std::vector<std::string>& paths,std::int64_t now,bool dry_run,const ClockAdapter& clocks,const ExpiredReference& expired_reference) {
L000412:     if(now<ActivityStore::RetentionMs)throw std::invalid_argument("trusted UTC is required for P1 retention");
L000413:     json databases=json::array();std::set<std::string> seen;bool complete=true;
L000414:     std::vector<std::string> resolved_paths;
L000415:     for(const auto& path:paths)resolved_paths.push_back(std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(std::filesystem::absolute(std::filesystem::u8path(path))).u8string());
L000416:     for(const auto& resolved:resolved_paths) {
L000417:         if(!seen.insert(resolved).second)continue;
L000418:         const auto lookup=[&](const std::string& activity,const std::string& source,const std::string& event){
L000419:             if(expired_reference&&expired_reference(activity,source,event))return true;
L000420:             for(const auto& other:resolved_paths)if(other!=resolved&&ExternalExpired(other,activity,source,event,clocks,now))return true;
L000421:             return false;
L000422:         };
L000423:         try {auto result=One(resolved,now,dry_run,clocks,lookup);complete=complete&&(result.at("status")=="CLEANED"||result.at("status")=="DRY_RUN");databases.push_back(std::move(result));}
L000424:         catch(const std::exception& error){complete=false;databases.push_back({{"path",resolved},{"status","ERROR"},{"reason",error.what()}});}
L000425:     }
L000426:     return {{"status",complete?"COMPLETE":"INCOMPLETE"},{"dry_run",dry_run},{"databases",databases}};
L000427: }

L000035: // A third camera's overlapping time interval can make nominal neighbours
L000036: // ambiguous too. Preserve the entire connected interval group's uncertainty.
L000037: std::set<std::string> AmbiguousOrder(const std::vector<const SightingEvidence*>& evidence) {
L000038:     const auto lower = [](const auto* e) {
L000039:         return e->captured_at_unix_ms < std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min() + e->clock_uncertainty_ms
L000040:             ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min() : e->captured_at_unix_ms - e->clock_uncertainty_ms;
L000041:     };
L000042:     const auto upper = [](const auto* e) {
L000043:         return e->captured_at_unix_ms > std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() - e->clock_uncertainty_ms
L000044:             ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() : e->captured_at_unix_ms + e->clock_uncertainty_ms;
L000045:     };
L000046:     auto intervals = evidence;
L000047:     std::sort(intervals.begin(), intervals.end(), [&](auto a, auto b) {
L000048:         if (lower(a) != lower(b)) return lower(a) < lower(b);
L000049:         return a->observation_id < b->observation_id;
L000050:     });
L000051:     std::set<std::string> ambiguous;
L000052:     for (std::size_t begin = 0; begin < intervals.size();) {
L000053:         auto end = begin + 1;
L000054:         auto latest = upper(intervals[begin]);
L000055:         std::set<std::string> cameras{intervals[begin]->camera_id};
L000056:         while (end < intervals.size() && lower(intervals[end]) <= latest) {
L000057:             latest = std::max(latest, upper(intervals[end]));
L000058:             cameras.insert(intervals[end++]->camera_id);
L000059:         }
L000060:         if (cameras.size() > 1)
L000061:             for (auto i = begin; i < end; ++i) ambiguous.insert(intervals[i]->observation_id);
L000062:         begin = end;
L000063:     }
L000064:     return ambiguous;
L000065: }

L000202: nlohmann::json CameraPointTrace(const TrajectorySnapshot& s, const nlohmann::json& p, const SiteContextStore& sites) {

L000208:         return std::tie(a->captured_at_unix_ms, a->observation_id) < std::tie(b->captured_at_unix_ms, b->observation_id);
L000209:     });

L000213:     for (const auto& a : s.anchors) anchor_visits[a.anchor_id] = a.visit_id;
L000214:     for (const auto& session : s.sessions) for (const auto& id : session.anchor_ids) {
L000215:         const auto found = anchor_visits.find(id);
L000216:         if (found != anchor_visits.end()) visit_sessions[found->second] = session.session_id;
L000217:     }
L000218:     for (const auto& visit : s.visits) {
L000219:         const auto found = visit_sessions.find(visit.visit_id);
L000220:         if (found != visit_sessions.end())
L000221:             for (const auto& id : visit.observation_ids) observation_sessions[id] = found->second;
L000222:     }
L000223:     std::map<std::string, json> contexts;
L000224:     const SightingEvidence* previous = nullptr;
L000225:     for (const auto* e : evidence) {
L000226:         if (!contexts.count(e->camera_id)) contexts[e->camera_id] = sites.CameraContext(p.at("scene_version"), e->camera_id, "CAMERA_ID", 0);
L000227:         const auto& context = contexts.at(e->camera_id);
L000228:         json positions = json::array();
L000229:         for (const auto& marker : context.at("candidate_markers")) positions.push_back({
L000230:             {"annotation_id", marker.at("annotation_id")}, {"source_scene_id", marker.at("source_scene_id")},
L000231:             {"name", marker.at("name")}, {"local_xyz", marker.at("local_xyz")}});

L000237:             {"position_semantics", "CAMERA_MARKER_NOT_PERSON_FOOTPOINT"}});

L000240:                 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(previous->captured_at_unix_ms);

L000242:                 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(previous->clock_uncertainty_ms);

L000246:             if (previous->camera_id != e->camera_id) {
L000247:                 const auto& from = observations[observations.size() - 2];
L000248:                 const auto& to = observations.back();

L000252:                     to_session != observation_sessions.end() && from_session->second == to_session->second;
L000253:                 const bool unique_positions = from.at("position_status") == "BOUND_MARKER" &&

L000255:                     from.at("position_candidates").size() == 1 && to.at("position_candidates").size() == 1;

L000259:                     coordinates.push_back(to.at("position_candidates")[0].at("local_xyz"));
L000260:                 }

L000262:                     {"from_observation_id", previous->observation_id}, {"to_observation_id", e->observation_id},
L000263:                     {"from_source_id", previous->source_id}, {"to_source_id", e->source_id},
L000264:                     {"from_camera_id", previous->camera_id}, {"to_camera_id", e->camera_id},
L000265:                     {"order_status", gap > errors && !ambiguous_order.count(previous->observation_id) &&
L000266:                         !ambiguous_order.count(e->observation_id) ? "ORDERED" : "UNCERTAIN_CLOCK_ORDER"},
L000267:                     {"drawing_status", !same_session ? "SESSION_BREAK" :
L000268:                         (unique_positions ? "DRAWABLE" : "UNRESOLVED_POSITION")},
L000269:                     {"coordinates", coordinates}, {"physical_path_observed", false},
L000270:                     {"meaning", "DIRECT_CAMERA_POINT_CONNECTION"}});
L000271:             }
L000272:         }
L000273:         previous = e;
L000274:     }
L000275:     return {{"target_id", s.target_id}, {"version", s.version}, {"scene_version", p.at("scene_version")},
L000276:         {"graph_version", s.graph.version}, {"coordinate_frame", p.at("coordinate_frame")},
L000277:         {"topology_verified", p.at("topology_verified")}, {"topology_is_complete", p.at("topology_is_complete")},
L000278:         {"observations", observations}, {"observation_order", order},
L000279:         {"drawing_mode", "CAMERA_POINT_CONNECTIONS"}, {"connections", connections},
L000280:         {"detailed_walk_path_observed", false}};
L000281: }
L000282: }

L000129:         if (ref.is_string() && ref == camera_ref) matches.insert(c.at("camera_id").get<std::string>());
L000130:     }
L000131:     if (matches.empty()) return result;
L000132:     if (matches.size() > 1) {result["status"] = "AMBIGUOUS_DEVICE"; result["camera_candidates"] = matches; return result;}

L000134:     result["status"] = "NO_PUBLISHED_CAMERA_MARKER";

L000136:     for (const auto& a : site.at("annotations")) {
L000137:         if (a.at("role") != "CAMERA" || a.at("camera_id") != camera_id || !a.at("visible").get<bool>()) continue;
L000138:         const auto p = ReadPoint(a.at("points")[0]); positions.push_back(p);
L000139:         json marker = a; marker["local_xyz"] = p; marker["world_ecef_xyz"] = World(site.at("to_world_matrix"), p);
L000140:         marker["nearby_annotations"] = json::array();

L000144:             if (nearest.first > radius_m) continue;

L000146:             nearby["nearest_local_xyz"] = nearest.second;
L000147:             marker["nearby_annotations"].push_back(std::move(nearby));
L000148:         }
L000149:         auto& nearby = marker["nearby_annotations"];

L000151:             if (x.at("distance_to_geometry_m") != y.at("distance_to_geometry_m")) return x.at("distance_to_geometry_m") < y.at("distance_to_geometry_m");

L000153:         });

L000155:     }
L000156:     if (positions.empty()) return result;
L000157:     double separation = 0;
L000158:     for (const auto& a : positions) for (const auto& b : positions) separation = std::max(separation, Distance(a, b));
L000159:     result["max_marker_separation_m"] = separation;
L000160:     result["status"] = separation > site.at("duplicate_tolerance_m").get<double>() ? "AMBIGUOUS_POSITION" : "BOUND_MARKER";

L000162:     // confirmed observation region. The caller retains all source candidates.
L000163:     return result;
L000164: }

L000033:         while (!queue.empty()) {
L000034:             auto [at,camera]=queue.top(); queue.pop();
L000035:             if (earliest.at(camera)!=at) continue;
L000036:             if (camera==to) return at;
L000037:             for (const auto& e:adjacency[camera]) {
L000038:                 if (!budget) {exhausted=true;return {}; } --budget;
L000039:                 auto depart=std::max(at,e.open_from_unix_ms.value_or(std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()));
L000040:                 if (depart>e.open_until_unix_ms.value_or(std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()) ||
L000041:                     depart>std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()-e.min_travel_ms) continue;
L000042:                 auto next=depart+e.min_travel_ms;
L000043:                 if (next>end) continue;
L000044:                 auto it=earliest.find(e.to_camera);
L000045:                 if (it==earliest.end() || next<it->second) {earliest[e.to_camera]=next;queue.push({next,e.to_camera});}
L000046:             }
L000047:         }
L000048:         return {};
L000049:     };
L000050:     std::map<std::string,std::int64_t> frontier;
L000051:     for (std::size_t begin=0;begin<captures.size();) {
L000052:         auto end=begin+1; auto upper=captures[begin].upper;
L000053:         while (end<captures.size() && captures[end].lower<=upper) {upper=std::max(upper,captures[end].upper);++end;}
L000054:         auto n=end-begin;
L000055:         const bool same=std::all_of(captures.begin()+begin,captures.begin()+end,[&](const auto& c){return c.camera_id==captures[begin].camera_id;});
L000056:         if (same) {
L000057:             std::optional<std::int64_t> at;
L000058:             if (frontier.empty()) at=captures[begin].lower;
L000059:             for (const auto& [camera,time]:frontier) {
L000060:                 auto t=arrive(camera,captures[begin].camera_id,time,captures[begin].upper);
L000061:                 if (t && (!at || *t<*at)) at=t;
L000062:             }
L000063:             for (auto i=begin;at && i<end;++i) {at=std::max(*at,captures[i].lower);if (*at>captures[i].upper) at.reset();}
L000064:             if (exhausted) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
L000065:             if (!at) return complete?ChainFeasibility::Infeasible:ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
L000066:             frontier={{captures[begin].camera_id,*at}};begin=end;continue;
L000067:         }
L000068:         if (n>12) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
L000069:         const std::size_t full=(std::size_t{1}<<n)-1;
L000070:         std::vector<std::optional<std::int64_t>> times((full+1)*n);
L000071:         for (std::size_t i=0;i<n;++i) {
L000072:             const auto& c=captures[begin+i]; auto& at=times[(std::size_t{1}<<i)*n+i];
L000073:             if (frontier.empty()) at=c.lower;
L000074:             for (const auto& [camera,time]:frontier) {
L000075:                 auto t=arrive(camera,c.camera_id,time,c.upper);
L000076:                 if (t) {t=std::max(*t,c.lower);if (!at || *t<*at) at=t;}
L000077:             }
L000078:         }
L000079:         for (std::size_t mask=1;mask<=full;++mask) for (std::size_t last=0;last<n;++last) {
L000080:             const auto at=times[mask*n+last]; if (!at) continue;
L000081:             for (std::size_t next=0;next<n;++next) if (!(mask&(std::size_t{1}<<next))) {
L000082:                 if (!budget) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown; --budget;
L000083:                 const auto& c=captures[begin+next];
L000084:                 auto t=arrive(captures[begin+last].camera_id,c.camera_id,*at,c.upper);
L000085:                 if (t) {t=std::max(*t,c.lower);auto& cell=times[(mask|(std::size_t{1}<<next))*n+next];if (!cell || *t<*cell) cell=t;}
L000086:                 if (exhausted) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
L000087:             }
L000088:         }
L000089:         frontier.clear();
L000090:         for (std::size_t last=0;last<n;++last) if (times[full*n+last]) {
L000091:             const auto& camera=captures[begin+last].camera_id; const auto at=*times[full*n+last];
L000092:             auto it=frontier.find(camera);if (it==frontier.end() || at<it->second) frontier[camera]=at;
L000093:         }
L000094:         if (exhausted) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
L000095:         if (frontier.empty()) return complete?ChainFeasibility::Infeasible:ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
L000096:         begin=end;
L000097:     }
L000098:     return ChainFeasibility::Feasible;
L000099: }
L000100: }

L000052: CameraGraph CanonicalGraph(CameraGraph graph) {
L000053:     if (graph.version.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("graph version is required");
L000054:     std::set<std::string> edge_ids;
L000055:     for (const auto& edge : graph.edges) {
L000056:         if (edge.from_camera.empty() || edge.to_camera.empty() ||
L000057:             edge.min_travel_ms < 0 || edge.max_travel_ms < edge.min_travel_ms ||
L000058:             !std::isfinite(edge.cost) || edge.cost < 0 ||
L000059:             (edge.open_from_unix_ms && edge.open_until_unix_ms &&
L000060:              *edge.open_from_unix_ms > *edge.open_until_unix_ms)) {
L000061:             throw std::invalid_argument("invalid camera edge");
L000062:         }
L000063:         if (!edge.edge_id.empty() && !edge_ids.insert(edge.edge_id).second) {
L000064:             throw std::invalid_argument("duplicate camera edge_id");
L000065:         }
L000066:     }
L000067:     std::sort(graph.edges.begin(), graph.edges.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
L000068:         return EdgeKey(a) < EdgeKey(b);
L000069:     });
L000070:     graph.edges.erase(std::unique(graph.edges.begin(), graph.edges.end(),
L000071:                                   [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
L000072:                                       return EdgeKey(a) == EdgeKey(b);
L000073:                                   }), graph.edges.end());
L000074:     return graph;
L000075: }

L000108:     if (b > 0 && a > std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() - b) return false;

L000114:     if (b > 0 && a < std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min() + b) return false;

L000119: std::optional<PathCandidate> EvaluatePath(const std::vector<const CameraEdge*>& path,
L000120:                                           const Anchor& from, const Anchor& to,
L000121:                                           double time_weight) {
L000122:     // Search gates the route with conservative endpoints. Timing uses the outer
L000123:     // feasible endpoints so actual traversals are not excluded from the output.
L000124:     const auto start = from.time_bounds.last_earliest_unix_ms;
L000125:     const auto end = to.time_bounds.first_latest_unix_ms;
L000126:     if (end < start) return std::nullopt;
L000127: 
L000128:     std::vector<std::int64_t> earliest(path.size() + 1);
L000129:     std::vector<std::int64_t> latest(path.size() + 1);
L000130:     earliest[0] = start;
L000131:     double edge_cost = 0;
L000132:     long double max_travel = 0;
L000133:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < path.size(); ++i) {
L000134:         const auto& edge = *path[i];
L000135:         const auto depart = std::max(earliest[i], edge.open_from_unix_ms.value_or(
L000136:             std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()));
L000137:         if (depart > edge.open_until_unix_ms.value_or(
L000138:                 std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()) ||
L000139:             !Add(depart, edge.min_travel_ms, earliest[i + 1]) || earliest[i + 1] > end) {
L000140:             return std::nullopt;
L000141:         }
L000142:         edge_cost += edge.cost;
L000143:         max_travel += edge.max_travel_ms;
L000144:     }
L000145:     latest.back() = end;
L000146:     for (std::size_t i = path.size(); i-- > 0;) {
L000147:         std::int64_t depart;
L000148:         if (!Subtract(latest[i + 1], path[i]->min_travel_ms, depart)) return std::nullopt;
L000149:         latest[i] = std::min(depart, path[i]->open_until_unix_ms.value_or(
L000150:             std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()));
L000151:         if (latest[i] < path[i]->open_from_unix_ms.value_or(
L000152:                 std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()) || latest[i] < earliest[i]) {
L000153:             return std::nullopt;
L000154:         }
L000155:     }
L000156: 
L000157:     PathCandidate candidate;
L000158:     candidate.nodes.push_back({from.camera_id, NodeStatus::Observed,
L000159:                                from.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms,
L000160:                                from.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms});
L000161:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < path.size(); ++i) {
L000162:         candidate.edge_ids.push_back(path[i]->edge_id);
L000163:         candidate.edge_time_bounds.push_back({
L000164:             std::max(earliest[i], path[i]->open_from_unix_ms.value_or(
L000165:                 std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min())), latest[i + 1]});
L000166:         if (i + 1 == path.size()) {
L000167:             candidate.nodes.push_back({to.camera_id, NodeStatus::Observed,
L000168:                                        to.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms,
L000169:                                        to.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms});
L000170:         } else {
L000171:             candidate.nodes.push_back({path[i]->to_camera, NodeStatus::Inferred,
L000172:                                        earliest[i + 1], latest[i + 1]});
L000173:         }
L000174:     }
L000175:     const auto available = static_cast<long double>(to.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms) -
L000176:                            static_cast<long double>(from.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms);
L000177:     candidate.edge_cost = edge_cost;
L000178:     candidate.time_penalty = static_cast<double>(
L000179:         std::max(0.0L, available - max_travel) / 1000.0L * time_weight);
L000180:     candidate.score = -candidate.edge_cost - candidate.time_penalty;
L000181:     return candidate;
L000182: }

L000198: CameraAdjacency BuildAdjacency(const CameraGraph& graph) {
L000199:     CameraAdjacency adjacency;
L000200:     for (const auto& edge : graph.edges) adjacency[edge.from_camera].push_back(&edge);
L000201:     return adjacency;

L000204: // Reverse Dijkstra gives a lower bound without coordinates or opening windows.
L000205: // Ignoring windows makes the bound optimistic, so pruning cannot remove a route.
L000206: std::map<std::string, std::int64_t> MinimumRemainingTravel(
L000207:     const CameraGraph& graph, const std::string& destination) {
L000208:     CameraAdjacency incoming;
L000209:     for (const auto& edge : graph.edges) incoming[edge.to_camera].push_back(&edge);
L000210:     using Entry = std::pair<std::int64_t, std::string>;
L000211:     std::priority_queue<Entry, std::vector<Entry>, std::greater<Entry>> pending;
L000212:     std::map<std::string, std::int64_t> minimum{{destination, 0}};
L000213:     pending.push({0, destination});
L000214:     while (!pending.empty()) {
L000215:         const auto [distance, camera] = pending.top();
L000216:         pending.pop();
L000217:         if (distance != minimum.at(camera)) continue;
L000218:         for (const auto* edge : incoming[camera]) {
L000219:             std::int64_t next;
L000220:             if (!Add(distance, edge->min_travel_ms, next)) continue;
L000221:             const auto found = minimum.find(edge->from_camera);
L000222:             if (found == minimum.end() || next < found->second) {
L000223:                 minimum[edge->from_camera] = next;
L000224:                 pending.push({next, edge->from_camera});
L000225:             }
L000226:         }
L000227:     }
L000228:     return minimum;
L000229: }
