L000231: TrajectorySegment BuildSegment(const Anchor& from, const Anchor& to,
L000232:                                const CameraGraph& graph, const CameraAdjacency& adjacency,
L000233:                                const TrajectoryOptions& options) {
L000234:     const auto from_earliest = from.time_bounds.last_earliest_unix_ms;
L000235:     const auto from_latest = from.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms;
L000236:     const auto to_earliest = to.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms;
L000237:     const auto to_latest = to.time_bounds.first_latest_unix_ms;
L000238:     const bool overlapping = to_earliest <= from_latest;
L000239:     TrajectorySegment segment{"segment:" + from.anchor_id + ":" + to.anchor_id,
L000240:                               graph.version,
L000241:                               from.anchor_id, to.anchor_id,
L000242:                               std::min(from_earliest, to_earliest),
L000243:                               std::max(from_latest, to_latest),
L000244:                               NodeStatus::Unknown, true, false, std::nullopt, {}};
L000245:     // Clock-overlapping observation intervals do not establish a movement order.
L000246:     if (overlapping) return segment;
L000247:     const auto minimum_remaining = MinimumRemainingTravel(graph, to.camera_id);
L000248:     std::vector<PathCandidate> found;
L000249:     std::vector<const CameraEdge*> path;
L000250:     std::set<std::string> visited{from.camera_id};
L000251:     std::size_t expansions = 0;
L000252:     bool expansion_limit = false;
L000253:     std::function<void(const std::string&, std::int64_t)> search =
L000254:         [&](const std::string& current, std::int64_t earliest) {
L000255:         auto it = adjacency.find(current);
L000256:         if (it == adjacency.end()) return;
L000257:         for (const auto* edge : it->second) {
L000258:             const bool at_destination = edge->to_camera == to.camera_id;
L000259:             if (!at_destination && visited.count(edge->to_camera)) continue;
L000260:             if (at_destination && edge->to_camera != from.camera_id &&
L000261:                 visited.count(edge->to_camera)) continue;
L000262:             const auto depart = std::max(earliest, edge->open_from_unix_ms.value_or(
L000263:                 std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()));
L000264:             std::int64_t arrival;
L000265:             if (depart > edge->open_until_unix_ms.value_or(
L000266:                     std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()) ||
L000267:                 !Add(depart, edge->min_travel_ms, arrival) || arrival > to_earliest) {
L000268:                 continue;
L000269:             }
L000270:             const auto remaining = minimum_remaining.find(edge->to_camera);
L000271:             std::int64_t earliest_finish;
L000272:             if (remaining == minimum_remaining.end() ||
L000273:                 !Add(arrival, remaining->second, earliest_finish) || earliest_finish > to_earliest) {
L000274:                 continue;
L000275:             }
L000276:             if (expansions == options.max_expansions) {
L000277:                 segment.search_complete = false;
L000278:                 expansion_limit = true;
L000279:                 return;
L000280:             }
L000281:             ++expansions;
L000282:             if (path.size() >= options.max_hops) {
L000283:                 // The hop cap is a resource limit, never evidence of uniqueness.
L000284:                 segment.search_complete = false;
L000285:                 continue;
L000286:             }
L000287:             path.push_back(edge);
L000288:             if (at_destination) {
L000289:                 auto candidate = EvaluatePath(path, from, to,
L000290:                                               options.travel_time_weight_per_second);
L000291:                 if (candidate) found.push_back(std::move(*candidate));
L000292:             } else {
L000293:                 visited.insert(edge->to_camera);
L000294:                 search(edge->to_camera, arrival);
L000295:                 visited.erase(edge->to_camera);
L000296:             }
L000297:             path.pop_back();
L000298:             if (expansion_limit) return;
L000299:         }
L000300:     };
L000301:     search(from.camera_id, from_latest);
L000302: 
L000303:     std::sort(found.begin(), found.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
L000304:         if (a.score != b.score) return a.score > b.score;
L000305:         return PathIdentity(a) < PathIdentity(b);
L000306:     });
L000307:     std::set<RouteIdentity> seen_paths;
L000308:     std::vector<PathCandidate> ranked;
L000309:     for (auto& candidate : found) {
L000310:         if (seen_paths.insert(PathIdentity(candidate)).second) {
L000311:             ranked.push_back(std::move(candidate));
L000312:         }
L000313:     }
L000314:     segment.unique_path = ranked.size() == 1 && segment.search_complete;
L000315:     if (!ranked.empty()) {
L000316:         segment.status = NodeStatus::Inferred;
L000317:         segment.primary = std::move(ranked[0]);
L000318:         for (std::size_t i = 1; i < ranked.size() &&
L000319:                                 i < options.max_candidates; ++i) {
L000320:             if (segment.primary->score - ranked[i].score > options.backup_score_margin) break;
L000321:             segment.backups.push_back(std::move(ranked[i]));
L000322:         }
L000323:     }
L000324:     return segment;
L000325: }
L000326: 
L000327: TrajectorySnapshot BuildSnapshot(const std::string& target_id,
L000328:                                  const std::vector<SightingEvidence>& sightings,
L000329:                                  const CameraGraph& graph,
L000330:                                  const TrajectoryOptions& options,
L000331:                                  std::uint64_t version) {
L000332:     auto built = BuildCameraVisits(sightings, options.max_visit_gap_ms,
L000333:                                    options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms, options.non_overlapping_cameras);
L000334:     TrajectorySnapshot result{target_id, version, graph, options, sightings,
L000335:                               std::move(built.visits), {}, {}, {},
L000336:                               std::move(built.rejected_observation_ids)};
L000337:     const auto adjacency = BuildAdjacency(graph);
L000338:     std::sort(result.visits.begin(), result.visits.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
L000339:         return std::tie(a.first_seen_unix_ms, a.last_seen_unix_ms, a.camera_id, a.visit_id) <
L000340:                std::tie(b.first_seen_unix_ms, b.last_seen_unix_ms, b.camera_id, b.visit_id);
L000341:     });
L000342:     for (const auto& visit : result.visits) {
L000343:         result.anchors.push_back({"anchor:" + visit.visit_id, visit.visit_id,
L000344:                                   visit.camera_id, visit.first_seen_unix_ms,
L000345:                                   visit.last_seen_unix_ms,
L000346:                                   visit.first_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms,
L000347:                                   visit.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms, visit.time_bounds});
L000348:     }
L000349:     std::size_t frontier = 0;
L000350:     std::vector<std::size_t> tied_frontiers;
L000351:     const auto refresh_frontiers = [&](std::size_t index) {
L000352:         tied_frontiers.push_back(index);
L000353:         std::int64_t latest_lower = std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min();
L000354:         for (const auto candidate : tied_frontiers) {
L000355:             const auto& anchor = result.anchors[candidate];
L000356:             latest_lower = std::max(latest_lower, anchor.time_bounds.last_earliest_unix_ms);
L000357:         }
L000358:         tied_frontiers.erase(std::remove_if(tied_frontiers.begin(), tied_frontiers.end(),
L000359:             [&](std::size_t candidate) {
L000360:                 const auto& anchor = result.anchors[candidate];
L000361:                 return anchor.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms < latest_lower;
L000362:             }), tied_frontiers.end());
L000363:         frontier = tied_frontiers.front();
L000364:     };
L000365:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < result.anchors.size(); ++i) {
L000366:         const auto& anchor = result.anchors[i];
L000367:         bool new_session = result.sessions.empty();
L000368:         if (!new_session) {
L000369:             const auto& session = result.sessions.back();
L000370:             const auto anchor_earliest = anchor.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms;
L000371:             const auto session_latest = session.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms;
L000372:             if (anchor_earliest > session_latest) {
L000373:                 const auto difference = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(anchor_earliest) -
L000374:                                         static_cast<std::uint64_t>(session_latest);
L000375:                 new_session = difference > static_cast<std::uint64_t>(options.session_gap_ms);
L000376:             }
L000377:         }
L000378:         if (new_session) {
L000379:             frontier = i;
L000380:             tied_frontiers = {i};
L000381:             result.sessions.push_back({"session:" + anchor.anchor_id,
L000382:                                        anchor.first_seen_unix_ms, anchor.last_seen_unix_ms,
L000383:                                        anchor.first_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms,
L000384:                                        anchor.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms,
L000385:                                        {anchor.anchor_id}, {}, anchor.time_bounds});
L000386:             continue;
L000387:         }
L000388:         auto& session = result.sessions.back();
L000389:         MergeCaptureTimeBounds(session.time_bounds, anchor.time_bounds);
L000390:         auto segment = BuildSegment(result.anchors[frontier], anchor, graph, adjacency, options);
L000391:         if (tied_frontiers.size() > 1) {
L000392:             std::optional<TrajectorySegment> sole_feasible;
L000393:             bool all_complete = true;
L000394:             std::size_t feasible_origins = 0;
L000395:             for (const auto index : tied_frontiers) {
L000396:                 const auto& origin = result.anchors[index];
L000397:                 auto candidate = index == frontier ? segment
L000398:                                                     : BuildSegment(origin, anchor, graph, adjacency, options);
L000399:                 all_complete &= candidate.search_complete;
L000400:                 if (candidate.primary) {
L000401:                     ++feasible_origins;
L000402:                     if (feasible_origins == 1) sole_feasible = std::move(candidate);
L000403:                 }
L000404:             }
L000405:             if (feasible_origins == 1) {
L000406:                 segment = std::move(*sole_feasible);
L000407:                 segment.search_complete = all_complete;
L000408:                 segment.unique_path &= all_complete;
L000409:             } else {
L000410:                 // Clock-overlapping last observations give no supported departure camera.
L000411:                 segment.status = NodeStatus::Unknown;
L000412:                 segment.search_complete = all_complete;
L000413:                 segment.unique_path = false;
L000414:                 segment.primary.reset();
L000415:                 segment.backups.clear();
L000416:             }
L000417:         }
L000418:         session.segment_ids.push_back(segment.segment_id);
L000419:         result.segments.push_back(std::move(segment));
L000420:         session.anchor_ids.push_back(anchor.anchor_id);
L000421:         if (anchor.last_seen_unix_ms > session.last_seen_unix_ms) {
L000422:             session.last_seen_unix_ms = anchor.last_seen_unix_ms;
L000423:             session.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms = anchor.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms;
L000424:         } else if (anchor.last_seen_unix_ms == session.last_seen_unix_ms) {
L000425:             session.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms = std::max(
L000426:                 session.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms,
L000427:                 anchor.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms);
L000428:         }
L000429:         refresh_frontiers(i);
L000430:     }
L000431:     return result;
L000432: }
L000433: 
L000434: bool SamePath(const PathCandidate& a, const PathCandidate& b) {
L000435:     if (a.score != b.score || a.edge_cost != b.edge_cost ||
L000436:         a.time_penalty != b.time_penalty || a.edge_ids != b.edge_ids ||
L000437:         a.edge_time_bounds != b.edge_time_bounds ||
L000438:         a.nodes.size() != b.nodes.size()) return false;
L000439:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < a.nodes.size(); ++i) {
L000440:         if (std::tie(a.nodes[i].camera_id, a.nodes[i].status,
L000441:                      a.nodes[i].earliest_unix_ms, a.nodes[i].latest_unix_ms) !=
L000442:             std::tie(b.nodes[i].camera_id, b.nodes[i].status,
L000443:                      b.nodes[i].earliest_unix_ms, b.nodes[i].latest_unix_ms)) return false;
L000444:     }
L000445:     return true;
L000446: }
L000447: 
L000448: bool SameSegment(const TrajectorySegment& a, const TrajectorySegment& b) {
L000449:     if (std::tie(a.graph_version, a.from_unix_ms, a.to_unix_ms, a.status, a.search_complete,
L000450:                  a.unique_path) !=
L000451:         std::tie(b.graph_version, b.from_unix_ms, b.to_unix_ms, b.status, b.search_complete,
L000452:                  b.unique_path) || a.primary.has_value() != b.primary.has_value() ||
L000453:         a.backups.size() != b.backups.size()) return false;
L000454:     if (a.primary && !SamePath(*a.primary, *b.primary)) return false;
L000455:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < a.backups.size(); ++i) {
L000456:         if (!SamePath(a.backups[i], b.backups[i])) return false;
L000457:     }
L000458:     return true;
L000459: }
L000460: 
L000461: std::vector<std::string> ChangedSegments(const TrajectorySnapshot* previous,
L000462:                                          const TrajectorySnapshot& next) {
L000463:     std::map<std::string, const TrajectorySegment*> old;
L000464:     if (previous) {
L000465:         for (const auto& segment : previous->segments) old[segment.segment_id] = &segment;
L000466:     }
L000467:     std::set<std::string> changed;
L000468:     for (const auto& segment : next.segments) {
L000469:         auto it = old.find(segment.segment_id);
L000470:         if (it == old.end() || !SameSegment(*it->second, segment)) {
L000471:             changed.insert(segment.segment_id);
L000472:         }
L000473:         old.erase(segment.segment_id);
L000474:     }
L000475:     for (const auto& [id, segment] : old) changed.insert(id);
L000476:     return {changed.begin(), changed.end()};
L000477: }
L000478: 
L000479: nlohmann::json AppendTailProof(const TrajectorySnapshot& snapshot) {
L000480:     if(snapshot.visits.empty() || !snapshot.rejected_observation_ids.empty() ||
L000481:        snapshot.visits.size()!=snapshot.anchors.size() || snapshot.sessions.empty()) return nullptr;
L000482:     const auto index=snapshot.anchors.size()-1;
L000483:     const auto& tail=snapshot.anchors.back();
L000484:     // A strictly later observation region excludes old interleaving evidence
L000485:     // that could split/merge the visit or change the incoming frontier.
L000486:     for(std::size_t i=0;i<index;++i)
L000487:         if(snapshot.anchors[i].time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms>=tail.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms) return nullptr;
L000488:     if(snapshot.sessions.back().anchor_ids.empty() || snapshot.sessions.back().anchor_ids.back()!=tail.anchor_id) return nullptr;
L000489:     nlohmann::json incoming=nullptr;
L000490:     for(std::size_t i=0;i<snapshot.segments.size();++i) {
L000491:         const auto& segment=snapshot.segments[i];
L000492:         if(segment.from_anchor_id==tail.anchor_id) return nullptr;
L000493:         if(segment.to_anchor_id==tail.anchor_id) { if(!incoming.is_null()) return nullptr; incoming=i; }
L000494:     }
L000495:     return {{"visit_index",index},{"anchor_index",index},{"session_index",snapshot.sessions.size()-1},{"incoming_segment_index",incoming}};
L000496: }
L000497: 
L000498: }  // namespace
L000499: 
L000500: CameraGraph NormalizeCameraGraph(CameraGraph graph) {
L000501:     return CanonicalGraph(std::move(graph));
L000502: }
L000503: 
L000504: std::vector<TrajectoryStore::TimedAnchor> TrajectoryStore::BuildTimelineIndex(
L000505:     const TrajectorySnapshot& snapshot) {
L000506:     std::map<std::string, std::size_t> observation_anchors;
L000507:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < snapshot.visits.size(); ++i) {
L000508:         for (const auto& id : snapshot.visits[i].observation_ids) {
L000509:             observation_anchors.emplace(id, i);
L000510:         }
L000511:     }
L000512:     std::vector<TimedAnchor> timed;
L000513:     timed.reserve(observation_anchors.size());
L000514:     // Evidence is in observation-ID order. Stable sorting retains its tie rule.
L000515:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < snapshot.evidence.size(); ++i) {
L000516:         const auto& sighting = snapshot.evidence[i];
L000517:         const auto it = observation_anchors.find(sighting.observation_id);
L000518:         if (it != observation_anchors.end()) {
L000519:             timed.push_back({sighting.captured_at_unix_ms, it->second, i});
L000520:         }
L000521:     }
L000522:     std::stable_sort(timed.begin(), timed.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
L000523:         return a.time < b.time;
L000524:     });
L000525:     return timed;
L000526: }
L000527: 
L000528: TrajectoryRevision TrajectoryStore::Rebuild(
L000529:     const std::string& target_id, const std::vector<SightingEvidence>& sightings,
L000530:     const CameraGraph& graph, const TrajectoryOptions& input_options,
L000531:     const std::string& reason, std::optional<std::uint64_t> expected_version) {
L000532:     if (target_id.empty() || reason.empty()) {
L000533:         throw std::invalid_argument("target_id and revision reason are required");
L000534:     }
L000535:     auto options=input_options;
L000536:     for(auto& pair:options.non_overlapping_cameras)if(pair.second<pair.first)std::swap(pair.first,pair.second);
L000537:     std::sort(options.non_overlapping_cameras.begin(),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end());
L000538:     options.non_overlapping_cameras.erase(std::unique(options.non_overlapping_cameras.begin(),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end()),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end());
L000539:     ValidateOptions(options);
L000540:     auto canonical_input = CanonicalSightings(target_id, sightings);
L000541:     auto canonical_graph = NormalizeCameraGraph(graph);
L000542:     const auto association_revision = association_revision_reader_ ? association_revision_reader_(target_id) : 0;
L000543:     const auto check_version = [&](std::uint64_t current, bool identical) {
L000544:         if (expected_version && *expected_version > current)
L000545:             throw std::runtime_error("VERSION_CONFLICT: expected_version is ahead of current trajectory version");
L000546:         // Same current input/binding is a safe retry after an acknowledgement loss.
L000547:         if (identical) return;
L000548:         if ((!expected_version && current != 0) || (expected_version && *expected_version != current))
L000549:             throw std::runtime_error("VERSION_CONFLICT: rebuild requires current expected_version=" + std::to_string(current));
L000550:     };
L000551:     if(state_) {
L000552:         auto known=state_->Get("trajectory_graph",canonical_graph.version);
L000553:         if(known && !SameGraph(nlohmann::json::parse(*known).get<CameraGraph>(),canonical_graph))
L000554:             throw std::invalid_argument("graph edges changed without a new graph version");
L000555:         auto head=state_->Get("trajectory_head",target_id);
L000556:         std::optional<TrajectorySnapshot> previous;
L000557:         if(head)previous=Get(target_id,std::stoull(*head));
L000558:         const bool identical = previous && previous->association_revision == association_revision &&
L000559:             SameSightings(previous->evidence,canonical_input) && SameGraph(previous->graph,canonical_graph) && SameOptions(previous->options,options);
L000560:         check_version(previous ? previous->version : 0, identical);
L000561:         if(identical)
L000562:             return {target_id,previous->version,previous->version,reason,{}};
L000563:         auto version=previous?previous->version+1:1;
L000564:         auto next=BuildSnapshot(target_id,canonical_input,canonical_graph,options,version);
L000565:         next.association_revision = association_revision;
L000566:         TrajectoryRevision revision{target_id,version-1,version,reason,ChangedSegments(previous?&*previous:nullptr,next)};
L000567:         next.revision=revision;
L000568:         const auto key=nlohmann::json::array({target_id,version}).dump();
L000569:         SharedJson shared(*state_);
L000570:         std::optional<nlohmann::json> shared_previous;
L000571:         if(previous) {
L000572:             const auto text=state_->Get("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({target_id,previous->version}).dump());
L000573:             if(text) { auto encoded=nlohmann::json::parse(*text); if(encoded.value("storage_format","")=="refs-v2") shared_previous=std::move(encoded); }
L000574:         }
L000575:         auto payload=shared.Encode(nlohmann::json(next),false,shared_previous);
L000576:         payload["storage_format"]="refs-v2";
L000577:         payload["append_tail"]=AppendTailProof(next);
L000578:         state_->Put("trajectory",key,payload.dump(),target_id);
L000579:         state_->Put("trajectory_head",target_id,std::to_string(version));
L000580:         state_->Put("trajectory_graph",canonical_graph.version,nlohmann::json(canonical_graph).dump());
L000581:         auto timed=BuildTimelineIndex(next);
L000582:         cold_cache_=StoredSnapshot{std::move(next),std::move(timed)};
L000583:         return revision;
L000584:     }
L000585:     auto it = histories_.find(target_id);
L000586:     if (it != histories_.end()) {
L000587:         for (const auto& stored : it->second.snapshots) {
L000588:             const auto& snapshot = stored.snapshot;
L000589:             if (snapshot.graph.version == canonical_graph.version &&
L000590:                 !SameGraph(snapshot.graph, canonical_graph)) {
L000591:                 throw std::invalid_argument("graph edges changed without a new graph version");
L000592:             }
L000593:         }
L000594:     }
L000595:     const bool identical = it != histories_.end() &&
L000596:         it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.association_revision == association_revision &&
L000597:         SameSightings(it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.evidence, canonical_input) &&
L000598:         SameGraph(it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.graph, canonical_graph) &&
L000599:         SameOptions(it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.options, options);
L000600:     const auto previous_version = it == histories_.end() ? 0 : it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.version;
L000601:     check_version(previous_version, identical);
L000602:     if (identical) {
L000603:         const auto version = it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.version;
L000604:         return {target_id, version, version, reason, {}};
L000605:     }
L000606:     auto next = BuildSnapshot(target_id, canonical_input, canonical_graph, options,
L000607:                               previous_version + 1);
L000608:     next.association_revision = association_revision;
L000609:     const auto previous = it == histories_.end() ? nullptr : &it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot;
L000610:     auto affected = ChangedSegments(previous, next);
L000611:     TrajectoryRevision revision{target_id, previous_version, previous_version + 1, reason,
L000612:                                 std::move(affected)};
L000613:     next.revision = revision;
L000614:     auto timed = BuildTimelineIndex(next);
L000615:     auto& history = histories_[target_id];
L000616:     history.snapshots.push_back({std::move(next), std::move(timed)});
L000617:     return revision;
L000618: }
L000619: 
L000620: std::optional<TrajectoryRevision> TrajectoryStore::TryAppend(
L000621:     const SightingEvidence& sighting, std::uint64_t previous_association_revision,
L000622:     const CameraGraph& graph, const TrajectoryOptions& input_options,
L000623:     const std::string& reason, std::uint64_t expected_version) {
L000624:     if(!state_ || expected_version==0 || reason.empty() ||
L000625:        LatestVersion(sighting.target_id)!=expected_version) return {};
L000626:     const auto text=state_->Get("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({sighting.target_id,expected_version}).dump());
L000627:     if(!text) return {};
L000628:     auto payload=nlohmann::json::parse(*text);
L000629:     if(payload.value("storage_format","")!="refs-v2" ||
L000630:        payload.at("association_revision").get<std::uint64_t>()!=previous_association_revision) return {};
L000631:     auto options=input_options;
L000632:     for(auto& pair:options.non_overlapping_cameras) if(pair.second<pair.first) std::swap(pair.first,pair.second);
L000633:     std::sort(options.non_overlapping_cameras.begin(),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end());
L000634:     options.non_overlapping_cameras.erase(std::unique(options.non_overlapping_cameras.begin(),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end()),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end());
L000635:     ValidateOptions(options);
L000636:     SharedJson shared(*state_);
L000637:     if(!SameGraph(shared.Decode(payload.at("graph")).get<CameraGraph>(),NormalizeCameraGraph(graph)) ||
L000638:        !SameOptions(shared.Decode(payload.at("options")).get<TrajectoryOptions>(),options)) return {};
L000639:     // The complete builder certifies the last visit as strictly later than
L000640:     // every other anchor. Missing/ambiguous certificates use the complete core.
L000641:     if(!payload.contains("append_tail") || payload.at("append_tail").is_null() ||
L000642:        SharedJson::Count(payload.at("rejected_observation_ids"))!=0 || !sighting.reentry_evidence_id.empty()) return {};
L000643:     const auto& proof=payload.at("append_tail");
L000644:     const auto visit_index=proof.at("visit_index").get<std::size_t>();
L000645:     const auto anchor_index=proof.at("anchor_index").get<std::size_t>();
L000646:     const auto session_index=proof.at("session_index").get<std::size_t>();
L000647:     auto visit=shared.At(payload.at("visits"),visit_index);
L000648:     const auto last=visit.at("last_seen_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
L000649:     if(visit.at("camera_id")!=sighting.camera_id || sighting.captured_at_unix_ms<=last ||
L000650:        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sighting.captured_at_unix_ms)-static_cast<std::uint64_t>(last)>
L000651:          static_cast<std::uint64_t>(options.max_visit_gap_ms)) return {};
L000652:     const auto admitted=BuildCameraVisits({sighting},options.max_visit_gap_ms,options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms,options.non_overlapping_cameras);
L000653:     if(admitted.visits.size()!=1 || !admitted.rejected_observation_ids.empty()) return {};
L000654:     const auto association_revision=association_revision_reader_?association_revision_reader_(sighting.target_id):0;
L000655:     if(association_revision<=previous_association_revision) return {};
L000656:     const auto old_bounds=visit.at("time_bounds").get<CaptureTimeBounds>();
L000657:     auto bounds=old_bounds;
L000658:     MergeCaptureTimeBounds(bounds,admitted.visits.front().time_bounds);
L000659:     // First bounds drive incoming travel feasibility, edge windows, scores and
L000660:     // session partitioning. Changing either requires full reconstruction.
L000661:     if(visit_index!=0 && (bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms!=old_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms ||
L000662:         bounds.first_latest_unix_ms!=old_bounds.first_latest_unix_ms)) return {};
L000663:     visit["time_bounds"]=bounds;
L000664:     visit["last_seen_unix_ms"]=sighting.captured_at_unix_ms;
L000665:     visit["last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms"]=sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms;
L000666:     visit["max_clock_uncertainty_ms"]=std::max(visit.at("max_clock_uncertainty_ms").get<std::int64_t>(),sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms);
L000667:     shared.Append(visit["observation_ids"],sighting.observation_id);
L000668:     shared.Append(visit["attribution_evidence_ids"],sighting.attribution_evidence_id);
L000669:     shared.Append(visit["source_ids"],sighting.source_id);
L000670:     shared.Set(payload["visits"],visit_index,visit);
L000671:     auto anchor=shared.At(payload.at("anchors"),anchor_index), session=shared.At(payload.at("sessions"),session_index);
L000672:     auto session_bounds=session.at("time_bounds").get<CaptureTimeBounds>();
L000673:     MergeCaptureTimeBounds(session_bounds,bounds);
L000674:     for(auto* item:{&anchor,&session}) {
L000675:         (*item)["last_seen_unix_ms"]=sighting.captured_at_unix_ms;
L000676:         (*item)["last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms"]=sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms;
L000677:     }
L000678:     anchor["time_bounds"]=bounds; session["time_bounds"]=session_bounds;
L000679:     shared.Set(payload["anchors"],anchor_index,anchor); shared.Set(payload["sessions"],session_index,session);
L000680:     shared.InsertEvidence(payload["evidence"],nlohmann::json(sighting));
L000681:     TrajectoryRevision revision{sighting.target_id,expected_version,expected_version+1,reason,{}};
L000682:     if(!proof.at("incoming_segment_index").is_null()) {
L000683:         const auto segment_index=proof.at("incoming_segment_index").get<std::size_t>();
L000684:         const auto encoded=shared.At(payload.at("segments"),segment_index);
L000685:         const auto old_segment=shared.Decode(encoded).get<TrajectorySegment>();
L000686:         auto segment=old_segment;
L000687:         const auto extend=[&](PathCandidate& candidate) {
L000688:             if(candidate.nodes.empty() || candidate.nodes.back().camera_id!=sighting.camera_id)
L000689:                 throw std::logic_error("invalid certified incoming trajectory endpoint");
L000690:             candidate.nodes.back().latest_unix_ms=bounds.last_latest_unix_ms;
L000691:         };
L000692:         if(segment.primary) extend(*segment.primary);
L000693:         for(auto& candidate:segment.backups) extend(candidate);
L000694:         if(!SameSegment(old_segment,segment)) {
L000695:             revision.affected_segment_ids.push_back(segment.segment_id);
L000696:             shared.Set(payload["segments"],segment_index,shared.Encode(nlohmann::json(segment),false,std::optional<nlohmann::json>(encoded)));
L000697:         }
L000698:     }
L000699:     payload["revision"]=shared.Encode(nlohmann::json(revision));
L000700:     payload["version"]=revision.version; payload["association_revision"]=association_revision;
L000701:     state_->Put("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({sighting.target_id,revision.version}).dump(),payload.dump(),sighting.target_id);
L000702:     state_->Put("trajectory_head",sighting.target_id,std::to_string(revision.version));
L000703:     cold_cache_.reset();
L000704:     return revision;
L000705: }
L000706: 
L000707: TrajectoryReference TrajectoryStore::Reference(const std::string& target_id,std::uint64_t version) const {
L000708:     if(state_) {
L000709:         if(version==0) version=LatestVersion(target_id);
L000710:         const auto text=state_->Get("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({target_id,version}).dump());
L000711:         if(!text) throw std::out_of_range("trajectory version not found");
L000712:         const auto payload=nlohmann::json::parse(*text);
L000713:         if(payload.value("storage_format","")=="refs-v2") return {version,payload.at("association_revision"),
L000714:             SharedJson::Count(payload.at("evidence")),SharedJson::Count(payload.at("anchors")),payload.at("graph").at("version")};
L000715:     }
L000716:     const auto& snapshot=Get(target_id,version);
L000717:     return {snapshot.version,snapshot.association_revision,snapshot.evidence.size(),snapshot.anchors.size(),snapshot.graph.version};
L000718: }
L000719: 
L000720: const TrajectorySnapshot& TrajectoryStore::Get(const std::string& target_id,
L000721:                                                 std::uint64_t version) const {
L000722:     if (version == 0 && association_revision_reader_) {
L000723:         const auto source_revision = association_revision_reader_(target_id);
L000724:         if (source_revision != 0 && LatestVersion(target_id) == 0)
L000725:             throw std::runtime_error("REBUILD_REQUIRED: no trajectory for current association; target=" + target_id);
L000726:         const auto& snapshot = Find(target_id, 0).snapshot;
L000727:         if (snapshot.association_revision != source_revision)
L000728:             throw std::runtime_error("REBUILD_REQUIRED: association revision changed; target=" + target_id +
L000729:                 "; current trajectory version=" + std::to_string(snapshot.version));
L000730:         return snapshot;
L000731:     }
L000732:     return Find(target_id, version).snapshot;
L000733: }

L000735: std::uint64_t TrajectoryStore::LatestVersion(const std::string& target) const {
L000736:     if (state_) return std::stoull(state_->Get("trajectory_head", target).value_or("0"));
L000737:     const auto found = histories_.find(target);
L000738:     return found == histories_.end() ? 0 : found->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.version;
L000739: }
L000740: 
L000741: nlohmann::json TrajectoryStore::Prune(std::int64_t cutoff_unix_ms, bool dry_run,
L000742:                                     const std::vector<std::string>& expired_observation_ids) {
L000743:     using J=nlohmann::json;
L000744:     // Snapshot versions are immutable to writers, but retention redacts all
L000745:     // of them. Removing only the head would leave queryable historical points.
L000746:     struct Candidate {
L000747:         std::string key;
L000748:         TrajectorySnapshot before;
L000749:         std::vector<SightingEvidence> retained;
L000750:     };
L000751:     std::vector<Candidate> candidates;
L000752:     if(state_) {
L000753:         std::vector<std::pair<std::string,std::string>> keys;
L000754:         state_->Scan("trajectory",[&](const std::string& key,const std::string& value){keys.emplace_back(key,value);});
L000755:         for(const auto& item:keys) {
L000756:             const auto key=J::parse(item.first);
L000757:             if(!key.is_array() || key.size()!=2)throw std::runtime_error("invalid persisted trajectory key");
L000758:             // Explicit versions avoid the association current-head assertion.
L000759:             candidates.push_back({item.first,Get(key.at(0).get<std::string>(),key.at(1).get<std::uint64_t>()),{}});
L000760:         }
L000761:     } else {
L000762:         for(const auto& target:histories_)for(const auto& stored:target.second.snapshots)
L000763:             candidates.push_back({J::array({target.first,stored.snapshot.version}).dump(),stored.snapshot,{}});
L000764:     }
L000765:     std::set<std::string> removed(expired_observation_ids.begin(),expired_observation_ids.end());
L000766:     std::set<std::string> removed_from_snapshots;
L000767:     std::uint64_t evidence_before=0,evidence_after=0,unknown_removed=0;
L000768:     for(auto& item:candidates) {
L000769:         for(const auto& sighting:item.before.evidence) {
L000770:             ++evidence_before;
L000771:             const bool qualified=sighting.time_source==TimeSource::UtcCapture && sighting.clock_domain=="UTC" &&
L000772:                 sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms>=0 && sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms<=60000;
L000773:             // An old snapshot has no first-quarantine provenance. Unqualified
L000774:             // evidence was never usable as a point, so remove it immediately
L000775:             // rather than inventing a fresh retention lease during migration.
L000776:             if(!qualified || removed.count(sighting.observation_id) || sighting.captured_at_unix_ms<cutoff_unix_ms) {
L000777:                 removed.insert(sighting.observation_id);
L000778:                 removed_from_snapshots.insert(sighting.observation_id);
L000779:                 if(!qualified)++unknown_removed;
L000780:             } else {
L000781:                 item.retained.push_back(sighting);
L000782:                 ++evidence_after;
L000783:             }
L000784:         }
L000785:     }
L000786:     std::uint64_t rewritten=0,deleted=0,empty_versions=0,rejected_removed=0,revision_ids_removed=0,reentry_removed=0;
L000787:     auto earliest=std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max();
L000788:     for(auto& item:candidates) {
L000789:         // A removal discovered in another historical version is authoritative
L000790:         // for the same immutable observation ID throughout this scope.
L000791:         item.retained.erase(std::remove_if(item.retained.begin(),item.retained.end(),[&](const auto& sighting){
L000792:             if(!removed.count(sighting.observation_id))return false;
L000793:             --evidence_after;
L000794:             return true;
L000795:         }),item.retained.end());
L000796:         bool scrubbed_reentry=false;
L000797:         for(auto& sighting:item.retained) {
L000798:             earliest=std::min(earliest,sighting.captured_at_unix_ms);
L000799:             if(!sighting.reentry_evidence_id.empty() && removed.count(sighting.reentry_evidence_id)) {
L000800:                 sighting.reentry_evidence_id.clear();scrubbed_reentry=true;++reentry_removed;
L000801:             }
L000802:         }
L000803:         auto next=BuildSnapshot(item.before.target_id,item.retained,item.before.graph,item.before.options,item.before.version);
L000804:         next.association_revision=item.before.association_revision;
L000805:         next.revision=item.before.revision;
L000806:         std::set<std::string> surviving_segments;
L000807:         for(const auto& segment:next.segments)surviving_segments.insert(segment.segment_id);
L000808:         auto& affected=next.revision.affected_segment_ids;
L000809:         const auto affected_before=affected.size();
L000810:         affected.erase(std::remove_if(affected.begin(),affected.end(),[&](const auto& id){return !surviving_segments.count(id);}),affected.end());
L000811:         revision_ids_removed+=affected_before-affected.size();
L000812:         std::set<std::string> surviving_rejected(next.rejected_observation_ids.begin(),next.rejected_observation_ids.end());
L000813:         std::uint64_t dropped_rejected=0;
L000814:         for(const auto& id:item.before.rejected_observation_ids)if(!surviving_rejected.count(id))++dropped_rejected;
L000815:         rejected_removed+=dropped_rejected;
L000816:         bool expired_reason=false;
L000817:         for(const auto& id:removed)if(!id.empty() && next.revision.reason.find(id)!=std::string::npos){expired_reason=true;break;}
L000818:         const bool changed=item.retained.size()!=item.before.evidence.size() || scrubbed_reentry ||
L000819:             dropped_rejected!=0 || affected_before!=affected.size() || expired_reason;
L000820:         if(next.evidence.empty()) {
L000821:             ++empty_versions;
L000822:             if(next.version!=LatestVersion(next.target_id)) {
L000823:                 ++deleted;
L000824:                 if(!dry_run) {
L000825:                     if(state_)state_->Erase("trajectory",item.key);
L000826:                     else {
L000827:                         auto& snapshots=histories_.at(next.target_id).snapshots;
L000828:                         snapshots.erase(std::remove_if(snapshots.begin(),snapshots.end(),[&](const auto& stored){
L000829:                             return stored.snapshot.version==next.version;
L000830:                         }),snapshots.end());
L000831:                     }
L000832:                 }
L000833:                 continue;
L000834:             }
L000835:         }
L000836:         if(!changed)continue;
L000837:         ++rewritten;
L000838:         // Historical revision free text can embed raw observation IDs. A
L000839:         // stable reason replaces it rather than retaining expired provenance.
L000840:         next.revision.reason="RETENTION_PRUNE";
L000841:         if(dry_run)continue;
L000842:         if(state_) {
L000843:             SharedJson shared(*state_);
L000844:             auto payload=shared.Encode(J(next));
L000845:             payload["storage_format"]="refs-v2";
L000846:             payload["append_tail"]=AppendTailProof(next);
L000847:             state_->Put("trajectory",item.key,payload.dump(),next.target_id);
L000848:         } else {
L000849:             auto& snapshots=histories_.at(next.target_id).snapshots;
L000850:             const auto found=std::find_if(snapshots.begin(),snapshots.end(),[&](const auto& stored){return stored.snapshot.version==next.version;});
L000851:             if(found==snapshots.end())throw std::logic_error("trajectory history disappeared during retention");
L000852:             auto timed=BuildTimelineIndex(next);
L000853:             *found=StoredSnapshot{std::move(next),std::move(timed)};
L000854:         }
L000855:     }
L000856:     if(!dry_run)cold_cache_.reset();
L000857:     return {{"cutoff_unix_ms",cutoff_unix_ms},{"dry_run",dry_run},{"versions_scanned",candidates.size()},
L000858:         {"earliest_retained_capture_unix_ms",earliest},
L000859:         {"versions_rewritten",rewritten},{"versions_deleted",deleted},{"empty_versions",empty_versions},{"evidence_before",evidence_before},
L000860:         {"evidence_after",evidence_after},{"evidence_removed",evidence_before-evidence_after},
L000861:         {"distinct_removed_observations",removed_from_snapshots.size()},{"unknown_time_evidence_removed",unknown_removed},
L000862:         {"rejected_ids_removed",rejected_removed},{"revision_ids_removed",revision_ids_removed},{"reentry_ids_removed",reentry_removed}};
L000863: }
L000864: 
L000865: const TrajectoryStore::StoredSnapshot& TrajectoryStore::Find(
L000866:     const std::string& target_id, std::uint64_t version) const {
L000867:     if(state_) {
L000868:         if(version==0){auto head=state_->Get("trajectory_head",target_id);if(!head)throw std::out_of_range("target trajectory not found");version=std::stoull(*head);}
L000869:         if(cold_cache_ && cold_cache_->snapshot.target_id==target_id && cold_cache_->snapshot.version==version)return *cold_cache_;
L000870:         auto text=state_->Get("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({target_id,version}).dump());
L000871:         if(!text)throw std::out_of_range("trajectory version not found");
L000872:         auto payload=nlohmann::json::parse(*text);
L000873:         if(payload.value("storage_format","")=="refs-v2") {
L000874:             SharedJson shared(*state_); payload=shared.Decode(payload);
L000875:         } else if(payload.contains("storage_format")) {
L000876:             if(payload.at("storage_format")!="refs-v1")throw std::runtime_error("unsupported trajectory storage format");
L000877:             auto object=[&](const std::string& key){auto value=state_->Get("object",key);if(!value)throw std::runtime_error("missing immutable trajectory object");return nlohmann::json::parse(*value);};
L000878:             payload["graph"]=object(payload.at("graph_ref").get<std::string>());
L000879:             payload["evidence"]=nlohmann::json::array();
L000880:             for(const auto& key:payload.at("evidence_refs"))payload["evidence"].push_back(object(key.get<std::string>()));
L000881:         }
L000882:         if (!payload.contains("association_revision")) payload["association_revision"] = 0;
L000883:         auto snapshot=payload.get<TrajectorySnapshot>();
L000884:         auto timed=BuildTimelineIndex(snapshot);cold_cache_=StoredSnapshot{std::move(snapshot),std::move(timed)};
L000885:         return *cold_cache_;
L000886:     }
L000887:     auto it = histories_.find(target_id);
L000888:     if (it == histories_.end() || it->second.snapshots.empty()) {
L000889:         throw std::out_of_range("target trajectory not found");
L000890:     }
L000891:     if (version == 0) return it->second.snapshots.back();
L000892:     const auto found=std::find_if(it->second.snapshots.begin(),it->second.snapshots.end(),[&](const auto& stored){
L000893:         return stored.snapshot.version==version;
L000894:     });
L000895:     if(found==it->second.snapshots.end())throw std::out_of_range("trajectory version not found");
L000896:     return *found;
L000897: }
L000898: 
L000899: TimelineResult TrajectoryStore::Query(const std::string& target_id,
L000900:                                       std::uint64_t version, std::int64_t at_unix_ms,
L000901:                                       std::int64_t from_unix_ms,
L000902:                                       std::int64_t to_unix_ms) const {
L000903:     if (from_unix_ms > at_unix_ms || at_unix_ms > to_unix_ms) {
L000904:         throw std::invalid_argument("timeline range must contain at_unix_ms");
L000905:     }
L000906:     if (version == 0) (void)Get(target_id, 0); // current reads must use current identity evidence
L000907:     const auto& stored = Find(target_id, version);
L000908:     const auto& snapshot = stored.snapshot;
L000909:     TimelineResult result{target_id, snapshot.version, at_unix_ms, NodeStatus::Unknown,
L000910:                           {}, {}, std::nullopt, std::nullopt, std::nullopt, {}, {}};
L000911:     for (const auto& anchor : snapshot.anchors) {
L000912:         if (anchor.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms <= to_unix_ms &&
L000913:             anchor.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms >= from_unix_ms) result.anchors_in_range.push_back(anchor);
L000914:     }
L000915:     const auto& timed = stored.timed_anchors;
L000916:     const auto error=snapshot.options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms;
L000917:     const auto lower=at_unix_ms<std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()+error
L000918:         ?std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min():at_unix_ms-error;
L000919:     const auto upper=at_unix_ms>std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()-error
L000920:         ?std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max():at_unix_ms+error;
L000921:     auto possible_begin=std::lower_bound(timed.begin(),timed.end(),lower,
L000922:         [](const TimedAnchor& item,std::int64_t time){return item.time<time;});
L000923:     auto possible_end=std::upper_bound(possible_begin,timed.end(),upper,
L000924:         [](std::int64_t time,const TimedAnchor& item){return time<item.time;});
L000925:     std::set<std::string> possible;
L000926:     for(auto it=possible_begin;it!=possible_end;++it){
L000927:         const auto& capture=snapshot.evidence[it->evidence_index];
L000928:         const auto distance=it->time<=at_unix_ms
L000929:             ?static_cast<std::uint64_t>(at_unix_ms)-static_cast<std::uint64_t>(it->time)
L000930:             :static_cast<std::uint64_t>(it->time)-static_cast<std::uint64_t>(at_unix_ms);
L000931:         if(distance<=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(capture.clock_uncertainty_ms))
L000932:             possible.insert(snapshot.anchors[it->anchor_index].anchor_id);
L000933:     }
L000934:     for(const auto& anchor:snapshot.anchors)if(possible.count(anchor.anchor_id))
L000935:         result.possible_observed_anchor_ids.push_back(anchor.anchor_id);
L000936:     const auto after = std::upper_bound(timed.begin(), timed.end(), at_unix_ms,
L000937:         [](std::int64_t time, const TimedAnchor& item) { return time < item.time; });
L000938:     const auto exact = std::lower_bound(timed.begin(),after,at_unix_ms,
L000939:         [](const TimedAnchor& item,std::int64_t time){return item.time<time;});
L000940:     for (auto it=exact;it!=after;++it) {
L000941:         const auto& id=snapshot.anchors[it->anchor_index].anchor_id;
L000942:         if (std::find(result.observed_anchor_ids.begin(),result.observed_anchor_ids.end(),id)==result.observed_anchor_ids.end())
L000943:             result.observed_anchor_ids.push_back(id);
L000944:     }
L000945:     if (after != timed.end()) {
L000946:         result.next_anchor_id = snapshot.anchors[after->anchor_index].anchor_id;
L000947:         result.next_observation = TimelineObservation{
L000948:             *result.next_anchor_id, snapshot.evidence[after->evidence_index]};
L000949:     }
L000950:     if (after != timed.begin()) {
L000951:         const auto previous_time = (after - 1)->time;
L000952:         const auto first_at_time = std::lower_bound(timed.begin(), after, previous_time,
L000953:             [](const TimedAnchor& item, std::int64_t time) { return item.time < time; });
L000954:         result.previous_anchor_id = snapshot.anchors[first_at_time->anchor_index].anchor_id;
L000955:         result.previous_observation = TimelineObservation{
L000956:             *result.previous_anchor_id, snapshot.evidence[first_at_time->evidence_index]};
L000957:     }
L000958:     const auto locate = [&](const TrajectorySegment& segment, const PathCandidate& path,
L000959:                             std::size_t route_index) {
L000960:         TimelinePathLocation location{segment.segment_id, route_index, {}, {}};
L000961:         for (std::size_t i = 0; i < path.nodes.size(); ++i) {
L000962:             const auto& node = path.nodes[i];
L000963:             if (node.earliest_unix_ms <= at_unix_ms && at_unix_ms <= node.latest_unix_ms) {
L000964:                 location.node_indices.push_back(i);
L000965:             }
L000966:         }
L000967:         for (std::size_t i = 0; i < path.edge_time_bounds.size(); ++i) {
L000968:             const auto& bound = path.edge_time_bounds[i];
L000969:             if (bound.earliest_unix_ms <= at_unix_ms && at_unix_ms <= bound.latest_unix_ms) {
L000970:                 location.edge_indices.push_back(i);
L000971:             }
L000972:         }
L000973:         if (!location.node_indices.empty() || !location.edge_indices.empty()) {
L000974:             result.path_locations.push_back(std::move(location));
L000975:         }
L000976:     };
L000977:     for (const auto& segment : snapshot.segments) {
L000978:         const auto start = std::min(segment.from_unix_ms, segment.to_unix_ms);
L000979:         const auto end = std::max(segment.from_unix_ms, segment.to_unix_ms);
L000980:         if (start <= to_unix_ms && end >= from_unix_ms) {
L000981:             result.segments_in_range.push_back(segment);
L000982:         }
L000983:         if (start <= at_unix_ms && end >= at_unix_ms) {
L000984:             result.active_segment_ids.push_back(segment.segment_id);
L000985:             if (segment.primary) locate(segment, *segment.primary, 0);
L000986:             for (std::size_t i = 0; i < segment.backups.size(); ++i) {
L000987:                 locate(segment, segment.backups[i], i + 1);
L000988:             }
L000989:         }
L000990:     }
L000991:     if (result.active_segment_ids.size() == 1) {
L000992:         result.segment_id = result.active_segment_ids[0];
L000993:         const bool primary_located = std::any_of(result.path_locations.begin(), result.path_locations.end(),
L000994:             [](const auto& location) { return location.route_index == 0; });
L000995:         if (primary_located) result.status = NodeStatus::Inferred;
L000996:     }
L000997:     if (!result.observed_anchor_ids.empty()) result.status = NodeStatus::Observed;
L000998:     else if (!result.possible_observed_anchor_ids.empty()) result.status = NodeStatus::Unknown;
L000999:     return result;
L001000: }

L000037: CaptureTimeBounds TimeBounds(const SightingEvidence& sighting) {

L000039:     const auto error = sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms;
L000040:     const auto lower = time < std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min() + error
L000041:         ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min() : time - error;

L000043:         ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() : time + error;

L000049: VisitBuildResult BuildCameraVisits(
L000050:     const std::vector<SightingEvidence>& sightings,
L000051:     std::int64_t max_gap_ms,
L000052:     std::int64_t max_clock_uncertainty_ms,
L000053:     const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>& non_overlapping_cameras) {
L000054:     if (max_gap_ms < 0 || max_clock_uncertainty_ms < 0) {
L000055:         throw std::invalid_argument("time limits must be nonnegative");
L000056:     }
L000057:     std::unordered_map<std::string, SightingEvidence> unique;
L000058:     VisitBuildResult output;
L000059:     for (const auto& sighting : sightings) {
L000060:         if (sighting.observation_id.empty() || sighting.target_id.empty() ||
L000061:             sighting.camera_id.empty() || sighting.attribution_evidence_id.empty() ||
L000062:             sighting.source_id.empty() || sighting.clock_domain.empty()) {
L000063:             throw std::invalid_argument("observation, target, camera, source, clock domain and attribution evidence IDs are required");
L000064:         }
L000065:         auto [found, inserted] = unique.emplace(sighting.observation_id, sighting);
L000066:         if (!inserted && !SameSighting(found->second, sighting)) {
L000067:             throw std::invalid_argument("conflicting duplicate observation_id");
L000068:         }
L000069:     }
L000070:     std::vector<SightingEvidence> ordered;
L000071:     std::set<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> disjoint;
L000072:     for (auto pair : non_overlapping_cameras) {
L000073:         if (pair.first.empty() || pair.second.empty() || pair.first == pair.second)
L000074:             throw std::invalid_argument("non-overlapping camera pair must contain distinct IDs");
L000075:         if (pair.second < pair.first) std::swap(pair.first, pair.second);
L000076:         disjoint.insert(std::move(pair));
L000077:     }
L000078:     ordered.reserve(unique.size());
L000079:     for (const auto& [id, sighting] : unique) {
L000080:         if (sighting.link_status != TargetLinkStatus::Confirmed ||
L000081:             sighting.time_source != TimeSource::UtcCapture ||
L000082:             sighting.clock_domain != "UTC" ||
L000083:             sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms < 0 ||
L000084:             sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms > max_clock_uncertainty_ms) {
L000085:             output.rejected_observation_ids.push_back(id);
L000086:         } else {
L000087:             ordered.push_back(sighting);
L000088:         }
L000089:     }
L000090:     std::sort(output.rejected_observation_ids.begin(), output.rejected_observation_ids.end());
L000091:     std::sort(ordered.begin(), ordered.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
L000092:         if (a.target_id != b.target_id) return a.target_id < b.target_id;
L000093:         if (a.camera_id != b.camera_id) return a.camera_id < b.camera_id;
L000094:         if (a.captured_at_unix_ms != b.captured_at_unix_ms) return a.captured_at_unix_ms < b.captured_at_unix_ms;
L000095:         return a.observation_id < b.observation_id;
L000096:     });
L000097:     std::map<std::string, std::vector<const SightingEvidence*>> target_evidence;
L000098:     if (!disjoint.empty()) {
L000099:         for (const auto& sighting : ordered) target_evidence[sighting.target_id].push_back(&sighting);
L000100:         for (auto& [id, evidence] : target_evidence)
L000101:             std::sort(evidence.begin(), evidence.end(), [](auto a, auto b) {
L000102:                 return std::tie(a->captured_at_unix_ms, a->observation_id) <
L000103:                        std::tie(b->captured_at_unix_ms, b->observation_id);
L000104:             });
L000105:     }
L000106:     for (const auto& sighting : ordered) {
L000107:         bool join = !output.visits.empty() &&
L000108:             output.visits.back().target_id == sighting.target_id &&
L000109:             output.visits.back().camera_id == sighting.camera_id &&
L000110:             sighting.reentry_evidence_id.empty() &&
L000111:             static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sighting.captured_at_unix_ms) -
L000112:                 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(output.visits.back().last_seen_unix_ms) <=
L000113:                 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(max_gap_ms);
L000114:         std::string boundary;
L000115:         if (join && !disjoint.empty()) {
L000116:             const auto lower = output.visits.back().time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms;
L000117:             const auto upper = TimeBounds(sighting).first_earliest_unix_ms;
L000118:             const auto& evidence = target_evidence.at(sighting.target_id);
L000119:             auto begin = std::upper_bound(evidence.begin(), evidence.end(), lower,
L000120:                 [](auto time, auto item) { return time < item->captured_at_unix_ms; });
L000121:             for (auto it = begin; it != evidence.end() && (*it)->captured_at_unix_ms < upper; ++it) {
L000122:                 const auto& other = **it;
L000123:                 auto pair = std::minmax(sighting.camera_id, other.camera_id);
L000124:                 const auto bounds = TimeBounds(other);
L000125:                 if (disjoint.count({pair.first, pair.second}) &&
L000126:                     bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms > lower && bounds.last_latest_unix_ms < upper) {
L000127:                     join = false;
L000128:                     boundary = other.observation_id;
L000129:                     break;
L000130:                 }
L000131:             }
L000132:         }
L000133:         if (join) {
L000134:             auto& visit = output.visits.back();
L000135:             MergeCaptureTimeBounds(visit.time_bounds, TimeBounds(sighting));
L000136:             if (sighting.captured_at_unix_ms == visit.first_seen_unix_ms) {
L000137:                 visit.first_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms = std::max(
L000138:                     visit.first_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms, sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms);
L000139:             }
L000140:             if (sighting.captured_at_unix_ms > visit.last_seen_unix_ms) {
L000141:                 visit.last_seen_unix_ms = sighting.captured_at_unix_ms;
L000142:                 visit.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms = sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms;
L000143:             } else {
L000144:                 visit.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms = std::max(
L000145:                     visit.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms, sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms);
L000146:             }
L000147:             visit.max_clock_uncertainty_ms = std::max(visit.max_clock_uncertainty_ms,
L000148:                                                      sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms);
L000149:             visit.observation_ids.push_back(sighting.observation_id);
L000150:             visit.attribution_evidence_ids.push_back(sighting.attribution_evidence_id);
L000151:             visit.source_ids.push_back(sighting.source_id);
L000152:         } else {
L000153:             output.visits.push_back({VisitId(sighting), sighting.target_id, sighting.camera_id,
L000154:                                      sighting.captured_at_unix_ms, sighting.captured_at_unix_ms,
L000155:                                      sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms, sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms,
L000156:                                      sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms,
L000157:                                      {sighting.observation_id}, {sighting.attribution_evidence_id},
L000158:                                      {sighting.source_id},
L000159:                                      sighting.reentry_evidence_id.empty()
L000160:                                          ? std::vector<std::string>{}
L000161:                                          : std::vector<std::string>{sighting.reentry_evidence_id},
L000162:                                      TimeBounds(sighting)});
L000163:             output.visits.back().boundary_observation_id = boundary;
L000164:         }
L000165:     }
L000166:     return output;
L000167: }
L000168: 
L000169: std::vector<CameraVisit> BuildRawTrajectory(
L000170:     const std::vector<SightingEvidence>& sightings,
L000171:     std::int64_t max_gap_ms,
L000172:     std::int64_t max_clock_uncertainty_ms,
L000173:     const std::string& target_id) {
L000174:     if (target_id.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("target_id is required");
L000175:     std::vector<SightingEvidence> matching;
L000176:     for (const auto& sighting : sightings) {
L000177:         if (sighting.target_id == target_id) matching.push_back(sighting);
L000178:     }
L000179:     const auto built = BuildCameraVisits(matching, max_gap_ms, max_clock_uncertainty_ms);
L000180:     std::vector<CameraVisit> trajectory;
L000181:     for (const auto& visit : built.visits) {
L000182:         if (visit.target_id != target_id) continue;
L000183:         trajectory.push_back(visit);
L000184:     }
L000185:     std::sort(trajectory.begin(), trajectory.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
L000186:         if (a.first_seen_unix_ms != b.first_seen_unix_ms) return a.first_seen_unix_ms < b.first_seen_unix_ms;
L000187:         if (a.last_seen_unix_ms != b.last_seen_unix_ms) return a.last_seen_unix_ms < b.last_seen_unix_ms;
L000188:         return a.camera_id < b.camera_id;
L000189:     });
L000190:     return trajectory;
L000191: }

L000304: json GraphToJson(const face_trajectory::CameraGraph& graph) {
L000305:     json edges = json::array();
L000306:     for (const auto& edge : graph.edges) {
L000307:         json item = {{"from_camera", edge.from_camera}, {"to_camera", edge.to_camera},
L000308:                      {"min_travel_ms", edge.min_travel_ms},
L000309:                      {"max_travel_ms", edge.max_travel_ms}, {"cost", edge.cost}};
L000310:         if (!edge.edge_id.empty()) item["edge_id"] = edge.edge_id;
L000311:         if (edge.open_from_unix_ms) item["open_from_unix_ms"] = *edge.open_from_unix_ms;
L000312:         if (edge.open_until_unix_ms) item["open_until_unix_ms"] = *edge.open_until_unix_ms;
L000313:         edges.push_back(std::move(item));
L000314:     }
L000315:     return {{"version", graph.version}, {"edges", edges}};
L000316: }

L000407: std::optional<std::uint64_t> ExpectedVersion(const json& request) {
L000408:     if (!request.contains("expected_version")) return {};
L000409:     const auto version = ReadInt64(request.at("expected_version"));

L000413: 
L000414: void ValidateAssociatedSightings(const std::string& target, const std::vector<SightingEvidence>& supplied,
L000415:                                 const face_trajectory::AssociationStore& associations) {
L000416:     if (associations.TargetRevision(target) == 0) return;
L000417:     const auto canonical = [](const auto& sightings) {
L000418:         std::map<std::string, json> by_id;
L000419:         for (const auto& sighting : sightings) {
L000420:             const auto value = EvidenceToJson(sighting);
L000421:             auto [it, inserted] = by_id.emplace(sighting.observation_id, value);
L000422:             if (!inserted && it->second != value) throw std::invalid_argument("conflicting duplicate observation_id");
L000423:         }
L000424:         return by_id;
L000425:     };
L000426:     if (canonical(supplied) != canonical(associations.Sightings(target)))
L000427:         throw std::runtime_error("SOURCE_CONFLICT: supplied set differs from current association; use association_rebuild");
L000428: }
L000429: 
L000430: json SnapshotFreshness(const face_trajectory::TrajectorySnapshot& snapshot, TrajectoryStore& trajectories,
L000431:                        const face_trajectory::AssociationStore& associations, bool historical) {
L000432:     const auto current_revision = associations.TargetRevision(snapshot.target_id);
L000433:     const auto latest_version = trajectories.LatestVersion(snapshot.target_id);
L000434:     const bool matches = snapshot.association_revision == current_revision;
L000435:     return {{"snapshot_association_revision", snapshot.association_revision},
L000436:         {"current_association_revision", current_revision}, {"latest_version", latest_version},
L000437:         {"association_matches_current", matches}, {"requested_scope", historical ? "HISTORICAL" : "CURRENT"},
L000438:         {"valid_for_current_use", matches && snapshot.version == latest_version},
L000439:         {"status", !matches ? "STALE_ASSOCIATION" : snapshot.version != latest_version ? "HISTORICAL" : "CURRENT"}};
L000440: }
L000441: 
L000442: void AddResultFreshness(json& response, const json& request, TrajectoryStore& trajectories,
L000443:                         const face_trajectory::AssociationStore& associations) {
L000444:     const auto op = request.value("op", "");
L000445:     if (op == "association_observe" || op == "association_correct") {
L000446:         auto effects = json::array();
L000447:         for (const auto& target_json : response.at("association").at("affected_target_ids")) {
L000448:             const auto target = target_json.get<std::string>();
L000449:             const auto head = trajectories.LatestVersion(target);
L000450:             const auto revision = associations.TargetRevision(target);
L000451:             const bool required = head == 0 || trajectories.Get(target, head).association_revision != revision;
L000452:             effects.push_back({{"target_id", target}, {"current_association_revision", revision},
L000453:                 {"latest_trajectory_version", head}, {"rebuild_required", required}});
L000454:         }
L000455:         response["association"]["trajectory_effects"] = effects;
L000456:         return;
L000457:     }
L000458:     const bool rebuild = op == "association_rebuild" || op == "trajectory_rebuild" || op == "point_trajectory_rebuild";
L000459:     if (!rebuild && op != "trajectory_get" && op != "point_trace" && op != "trajectory_predict" &&
L000460:         op != "trajectory_geometry" && op != "timeline_query" && op != "point_prediction_compare") return;
L000461:     const auto target = request.at("target_id").get<std::string>();
L000462:     const auto version = rebuild ? response.at("revision").at("version").get<std::uint64_t>()
L000463:         : static_cast<std::uint64_t>(request.contains("version") ? ReadInt64(request.at("version")) : 0);
L000464:     const auto freshness = SnapshotFreshness(trajectories.Get(target, version), trajectories, associations, !rebuild && version != 0);
L000465:     response["freshness"] = freshness;
L000466:     for (const auto* key : {"trajectory", "point_trace", "prediction", "geometry", "timeline", "comparison"})
L000467:         if (response.contains(key)) response[key]["freshness"] = freshness;
L000468: }
L000469: 
L000470: json MonitoringTime(face_trajectory::ClockAdapter& clocks, const json& request,
L000471:                     const std::string& camera = "", const std::string& source = "") {
L000472:     const json unavailable={{"status","HOLD"},{"reason_codes",json::array({"CAPTURE_TIME_UNAVAILABLE"})},
L000473:         {"provenance",{{"time_policy","CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S"},{"camera_id",camera},{"profile_version",""},
L000474:             {"raw_time",""},{"offset_convention","POSITIVE_CAMERA_AHEAD"}}}};
L000475:     if(!request.contains("time_record") || request.at("time_record").is_null()) return unavailable;
L000476:     auto record=request.at("time_record");
L000477:     if(!record.is_object()) throw std::invalid_argument("time_record must be an object or null");
L000478:     if(!camera.empty()) {
L000479:         if(record.contains("camera_id") && record.at("camera_id")!=camera)
L000480:             throw std::invalid_argument("time_record camera differs from observation");
L000481:         record["camera_id"]=camera;
L000482:     }
L000483:     if(!source.empty() && record.contains("source_id") && record.at("source_id")!=source)
L000484:         throw std::invalid_argument("time_record source differs from observation");
L000485:     if(record.contains("time_policy") && record.at("time_policy")!="CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S")
L000486:         throw std::invalid_argument("monitoring time_policy is fixed to CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S");
L000487:     for(const auto* field:{"profile_version","camera_id","raw_time"})
L000488:         if(!record.contains(field) || record.at(field).is_null() || record.at(field)=="") return unavailable;
L000489:     record["time_policy"]="CAMERA_CAPTURE_60S";
L000490:     auto normalized=clocks.Normalize(record);
L000491:     if(normalized.value("status","")=="NORMALIZED" && request.contains("_trusted_clock")) {
L000492:         const auto capture=normalized.at("captured_at_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
L000493:         const auto now=request.at("_trusted_clock").at("now_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
L000494:         if(capture>now && capture-now>face_trajectory::ClockAdapter::CameraCaptureErrorLimitMs){
L000495:             normalized["status"]="HOLD";normalized["reason_codes"]=json::array({"FUTURE_CAPTURE_TIME_OVER_60S"});
L000496:         }
L000497:     }
L000498:     return normalized;
L000499: }
L000500: 
L000501: json Execute(Gallery& gallery, TrajectoryStore& trajectories,
L000502:              face_trajectory::AssociationStore& associations, face_trajectory::GeometryStore& geometry,
L000503:              face_trajectory::SiteContextStore& site_context, face_trajectory::ClockAdapter& clocks,
L000504:              face_trajectory::PointGraphStore& point_graphs, face_trajectory::MonitoringStore& monitoring,
L000505:              const json& request) {
L000506:     const auto op = request.at("op").get<std::string>();
L000507:     if(op=="monitoring_person_put") return monitoring.PutPerson(request,gallery);
L000508:     if(op=="monitoring_get") return {{"ok",true},{"monitoring",monitoring.Get(request.at("target_id"),associations)}};
L000509:     if(op=="monitoring_gate_event") {
L000510:         monitoring.RequireDurable();
L000511:         return monitoring.PutGate(request,MonitoringTime(clocks,request),associations);
L000512:     }
L000513:     if(op=="monitoring_observe") {
L000514:         monitoring.RequireDurable();
L000515:         if(const auto previous=monitoring.ObservationReceipt(request)) return *previous;
L000516:         auto observation=request.at("observation");
L000517:         if(request.contains("target_id") || observation.contains("target_id") || observation.contains("person_id"))
L000518:             throw std::invalid_argument("monitoring observation cannot assert target identity");
L000519:         const auto id=observation.at("observation_id").get<std::string>();
L000520:         const auto camera=observation.at("camera_id").get<std::string>();
L000521:         const auto source=observation.at("source_id").get<std::string>();
L000522:         if(id.empty() || camera.empty() || source.empty() || observation.at("frame_id").get<std::string>().empty())
L000523:             throw std::invalid_argument("observation/source/camera/frame ID is required");
L000524:         Gallery::ValidateQuery(ReadSpace(observation.at("feature_space")),ReadEmbedding(observation.at("embedding")));
L000525:         auto policy=ReadAssociationPolicy(request.at("policy"));
L000526:         if(!request.at("policy").contains("max_clock_uncertainty_ms")) policy.max_clock_uncertainty_ms=60000;
L000527:         auto options=ReadOptions(request);
L000528:         if(!request.contains("options") || !request.at("options").contains("max_clock_uncertainty_ms"))
L000529:             options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms=60000;
L000530:         if(policy.max_clock_uncertainty_ms<0 || policy.max_clock_uncertainty_ms>60000 ||
L000531:            options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms<0 || options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms>60000)
L000532:             throw std::invalid_argument("monitoring clock policy must be within 0..60000");
L000533:         const auto graph=ReadGraph(request.at("graph"));
L000534:         auto normalized=MonitoringTime(clocks,request,camera,source);
L000535:         auto reasons=normalized.at("reason_codes");
L000536:         if(normalized.at("status")=="NORMALIZED" && ReadInt64(normalized.at("clock_uncertainty_ms"))>
L000537:            std::min(policy.max_clock_uncertainty_ms,options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms))
L000538:             reasons.push_back("CLOCK_UNCERTAINTY_EXCEEDS_POLICY");
L000539:         json response={{"ok",true},{"observation_id",id},{"status","HOLD"},{"normalization",normalized},
L000540:             {"time_admitted",reasons.empty()},
L000541:             {"receipt_scope","ORIGINAL_TRANSACTION"},
L000542:             {"reason_codes",reasons},{"association",nullptr},{"monitoring",nullptr},{"trajectories",json::array()}};
L000543:         if(!reasons.empty()) { monitoring.SaveObservation(request,response); return response; }
L000544:         for(const auto* field:{"captured_at_unix_ms","clock_uncertainty_ms","time_source","clock_domain"})
L000545:             observation[field]=normalized.at(field);
L000546:         const auto result=associations.Observe(ReadFaceObservation(observation),policy,graph,request.value("reconsider",false));
L000547:         const auto append=associations.LastAppend();
L000548:         response["association"]=AssociationToJson(result);
L000549:         if(result.sighting) response["status"]="ACCEPTED";
L000550:         else response["reason_codes"].push_back("FACE_"+result.decision);
L000551:         monitoring.SaveObservation(request,response);
L000552:         if(result.sighting) {
L000553:             for(const auto& target:result.affected_target_ids) {
L000554:                 const auto head=trajectories.LatestVersion(target);
L000555:                 auto appended=append && append->sighting.target_id==target
L000556:                     ? trajectories.TryAppend(append->sighting,append->previous_target_revision,graph,options,"MONITORING_OBSERVATION:"+id,head)
L000557:                     : std::optional<face_trajectory::TrajectoryRevision>{};
L000558:                 const auto revision=appended?*appended:trajectories.Rebuild(target,associations.Sightings(target),graph,options,
L000559:                     "MONITORING_OBSERVATION:"+id,head);
L000560:                 const auto snapshot=trajectories.Reference(target,revision.version);
L000561:                 response["trajectories"].push_back({{"revision",RevisionToJson(revision)},{"target_id",target},
L000562:                     {"version",revision.version},{"association_revision",snapshot.association_revision},
L000563:                     {"observation_count",snapshot.observation_count},{"anchor_count",snapshot.anchor_count},
L000564:                     {"graph_version",snapshot.graph_version},{"detail_query","POST /v1/trajectories/get"}});
L000565:             }
L000566:             response["monitoring"]=monitoring.ObserveSummary(*result.sighting,
L000567:                 append?std::optional<std::uint64_t>(append->previous_target_revision):std::nullopt,associations);
L000568:         }
L000569:         monitoring.CompleteObservationReceipt(id,response);
L000570:         return response;
L000571:     }
L000572:     if (op == "clock_profile_put") { clocks.Put(request.at("profile")); return {{"ok", true}}; }
L000573:     if (op == "clock_normalize") return {{"ok", true}, {"normalization", clocks.Normalize(request)}};
L000574:     if (op == "point_graph_put") {
L000575:         point_graphs.Put(request.at("point_graph"), site_context);
L000576:         return {{"ok", true}, {"graph_version", request.at("point_graph").at("graph_version")}};
L000577:     }
L000578:     if (op == "point_graph_get") return {{"ok", true}, {"point_graph", point_graphs.Get(request.at("graph_version"))}};
L000579:     if (op == "point_trajectory_rebuild") {
L000580:         const auto target = request.at("target_id").get<std::string>();
L000581:         const auto graph_version = request.at("graph_version").get<std::string>();
L000582:         const auto packet = point_graphs.Get(graph_version);
L000583:         auto options = ReadOptions(request);
L000584:         if (!request.contains("options") || !request.at("options").contains("max_clock_uncertainty_ms"))
L000585:             options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms = face_trajectory::ClockAdapter::CameraCaptureErrorLimitMs;
L000586:         if (options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms < 0 ||
L000587:             options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms > face_trajectory::ClockAdapter::CameraCaptureErrorLimitMs)
L000588:             throw std::invalid_argument("point trajectory max_clock_uncertainty_ms must be within 0..60000");
L000589:         json admissions = json::array(), sightings = json::array();
L000590:         if (!request.at("records").is_array()) throw std::invalid_argument("records must be an array");
L000591:         std::map<std::string, std::string> unique_records;
L000592:         for (const auto& record : request.at("records")) {
L000593:             const auto id = record.at("observation_id").get<std::string>();
L000594:             if (id.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("observation_id is required");
L000595:             const auto encoded = record.dump();

L000853: bool ReadBoundedLine(std::string& line, bool& too_large) {
L000854:     constexpr std::size_t kMaxLine = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
L000855:     line.clear();
L000856:     too_large = false;
L000857:     bool saw_input = false;
L000858:     for (;;) {
L000859:         const int next = std::cin.get();
L000860:         if (next == EOF) return saw_input;
L000861:         saw_input = true;
L000862:         if (next == '\n') return true;
L000863:         if (line.size() < kMaxLine && !too_large) {
L000864:             line.push_back(static_cast<char>(next));
L000865:         } else {
L000866:             too_large = true;
L000867:         }
L000868:     }
L000869: }

L000871: bool PushOperation(const std::string& op) {
L000872:     return op == "association_observe" || op == "association_correct" ||
L000873:         op == "association_rebuild" || op == "trajectory_rebuild" || op == "point_trajectory_rebuild" ||
L000874:         op == "monitoring_observe" || op == "monitoring_gate_event" || op == "monitoring_person_put";
L000875: }
