L000001: """Offline evaluation of saved worker decisions against independent event labels.
L000002: 
L000003: This tool never calls a worker, generates identities, changes a model or policy,
L000004: or infers truth from file names, automatic GIDs, or predictions. Every input row
L000005: must have a complete independent label, including rejected/HOLD observations.
L000006: Scope is P2_FEATURE_EVENTS: already-extracted feature events and their worker
L000007: intake/association outcomes. Image-level missed detections and P1 quality-rejected
L000008: images are outside this dataset; this cannot prove end-to-end accuracy gains.
L000009: The independence declaration and evidence reference must be supplied by the
L000010: label owner; validating the declaration cannot prove that review took place.
L000011: 
L000012: Truth JSONL: activity_id, source_id, observation_id, episode_id, truth_person_id,
L000013: enrolled_target_id (string or null), truth_complete=true, truth_evidence_id,
L000014: label_origin=INDEPENDENT_REVIEW or SYNTHETIC_INDEPENDENT_FIXTURE.
L000015: Prediction JSONL: the same three event key fields, input_sha256, feature_space,
L000016: and result (the saved worker response, including status and association).
L000017: Manifest JSON: schema_version=1, dataset_id, truth_sha256, worker_sha256,
L000018: evidence_kind=INDEPENDENT_LABELLED or SYNTHETIC_TOOL_CONTRACT,
L000019: ground_truth_independent=true, input_stage=P2_FEATURE_EVENTS, embedding_dim=512,
L000020: feature_space, identity_policy, complete eight-field quality_policy,
L000021: enrollment_sha256, graph_sha256, clock_profiles_sha256,
L000022: replay_mode=AUTOMATIC_OBSERVATION_REPLAY, request_timeline_sha256,
L000023: operation_inventory (operation -> positive integer count),
L000024: registered_target_ids (activity -> all explicitly enrolled target IDs).
L000025: Hashes freeze the independently recorded complete enrollment/config requests
L000026: (including every template vector), graph and clock profile artifacts. They are
L000027: audit declarations; reviewers must check them against the saved setup I/O and
L000028: artifacts. A supplied hash or response cannot prove worker execution or GT review.
L000029: The complete ordered request timeline includes setup, clocks and observations,
L000030: without GT fields. Only the six setup/observation operations listed below are
L000031: allowed; CORRECTED decisions and manual attribution corrections are excluded
L000032: from automatic algorithm evaluation. The reader cannot detect operations omitted
L000033: from a supplied inventory or prove a supplied timeline digest was executed.
L000034: 
L000035: Anonymous pair counts are computed within (activity_id, episode_id), allowing
L000036: independently labelled cross-source events in an episode, never across activities.
L000037: Abstention breaks a same-person pair and counts as a false split. Missing rows
L000038: are validation errors, never implicit abstentions. Rates with zero denominators
L000039: are null. Comparison freezes model, feature-space, policies, roster, labels and
L000040: event inputs. Worker code hashes may differ, permitting a code-fix comparison.
L000041: 
L000042: The pair confusion-count definitions follow the independent same/different-label
L000043: evaluation pattern in InsightFace's MIT-licensed verification.py. No upstream
L000044: inference, PCA, flipping, threshold selection, or framework dependency is used.

L000293: def _rate(numerator, denominator):
L000294:     return numerator / denominator if denominator else None

L000297: def _pairs(counts):
L000298:     return sum(n * (n - 1) // 2 for n in counts.values())

L000301: def _metrics(truth, predictions, manifest):
L000302:     counts = Counter(total_events=len(truth))
L000303:     statuses, decisions = Counter(), Counter()
L000304:     anonymous = defaultdict(list)
L000305:     events = []
L000306:     for key in sorted(truth):
L000307:         label, result = truth[key], predictions[key]["result"]
L000308:         status = result["status"]
L000309:         association = result.get("association") or {}
L000310:         decision = association.get("decision")
L000311:         target = association.get("target_id") if decision in ACCEPTED_DECISIONS else None
L000312:         statuses[status] += 1
L000313:         decisions[decision or "NO_ASSOCIATION"] += 1
L000314:         counts["intake_accepted"] += status == "ACCEPTED"
L000315:         counts["confirmed_associations"] += target is not None
L000316:         expected = label["enrolled_target_id"]
L000317:         if expected is not None:
L000318:             counts["enrolled_events"] += 1
L000319:             counts["enrolled_correct_accepts"] += target == expected
L000320:             counts["enrolled_wrong_associations"] += target is not None and target != expected
L000321:             counts["enrolled_wrong_registered_accepts"] += (target is not None and target != expected and
L000322:                                                             target in manifest["registered_target_ids"][key[0]])
L000323:             counts["enrolled_abstentions"] += target is None
L000324:         else:
L000325:             counts["unenrolled_events"] += 1
L000326:             counts["unknown_false_registered_accepts"] += target in manifest["registered_target_ids"][key[0]]
L000327:             counts["anonymous_confirmed_events"] += target is not None
L000328:             anonymous[(key[0], label["episode_id"])].append((label["truth_person_id"], target))
L000329:         events.append({**dict(zip(KEY_FIELDS, key)), "status": status, "decision": decision,
L000330:                        "predicted_target_id": target, "truth_person_id": label["truth_person_id"],
L000331:                        "enrolled_target_id": expected, "reason": association.get("reason", result.get("reason"))})
L000332:     pair_counts = Counter(total_pairs=0, truth_same_pairs=0, predicted_same_pairs=0,
L000333:                           true_same_pairs=0, false_merge_pairs=0, false_split_pairs=0)
L000334:     for group in anonymous.values():
L000335:         gt = Counter(person for person, _ in group)
L000336:         predicted = Counter(target for _, target in group if target is not None)
L000337:         joint = Counter((person, target) for person, target in group if target is not None)
L000338:         same_truth, same_prediction, correct = _pairs(gt), _pairs(predicted), _pairs(joint)
L000339:         pair_counts["total_pairs"] += len(group) * (len(group) - 1) // 2
L000340:         pair_counts["truth_same_pairs"] += same_truth
L000341:         pair_counts["predicted_same_pairs"] += same_prediction
L000342:         pair_counts["true_same_pairs"] += correct
L000343:         pair_counts["false_merge_pairs"] += same_prediction - correct
L000344:         pair_counts["false_split_pairs"] += same_truth - correct
L000345:     for field in ("enrolled_events", "enrolled_correct_accepts", "enrolled_wrong_associations",
L000346:                   "enrolled_wrong_registered_accepts", "enrolled_abstentions", "unenrolled_events",
L000347:                   "unknown_false_registered_accepts", "anonymous_confirmed_events"):
L000348:         counts.setdefault(field, 0)
L000349:     return {"counts": dict(counts), "statuses": dict(statuses), "decisions": dict(decisions),
L000350:             "rates": {"enrolled_correct_recall": _rate(counts["enrolled_correct_accepts"], counts["enrolled_events"]),
L000351:                       "enrolled_wrong_association_rate": _rate(counts["enrolled_wrong_associations"], counts["enrolled_events"]),
L000352:                       "unknown_false_registered_accept_rate": _rate(counts["unknown_false_registered_accepts"], counts["unenrolled_events"]),
L000353:                       "confirmed_coverage": _rate(counts["confirmed_associations"], len(truth)),
L000354:                       "hold_rate": _rate(statuses["HOLD"], len(truth))},
L000355:             "anonymous_pairs": {**dict(pair_counts),
L000356:                                 "precision": _rate(pair_counts["true_same_pairs"], pair_counts["predicted_same_pairs"]),
L000357:                                 "recall": _rate(pair_counts["true_same_pairs"], pair_counts["truth_same_pairs"])},
L000358:             "events": events}

L000361: def evaluate_files(truth_path, predictions_path, manifest_path, *,
L000362:                    baseline_predictions_path=None, baseline_manifest_path=None):
L000363:     _require(bool(baseline_predictions_path) == bool(baseline_manifest_path),
L000364:              "baseline predictions and manifest must be provided together")

L000366:     manifest = _manifest(manifest_path, truth_path)
L000367:     _validate_truth(truth, manifest)
L000368:     predictions = _rows(predictions_path)
L000369:     _validate_predictions(predictions, truth, manifest)
L000370:     def metrics_by_activity(values, meta):
L000371:         metrics = _metrics(truth, values, meta)
L000372:         metrics["by_activity"] = {}
L000373:         for activity in sorted({key[0] for key in truth}):
L000374:             selected = {key: row for key, row in truth.items() if key[0] == activity}
L000375:             detail = _metrics(selected, values, meta)
L000376:             detail.pop("events")

L000380:     report = {"schema_version": 1, "evidence_kind": manifest["evidence_kind"],
L000381:               "scope": "offline supplied P2 feature-event worker responses; excludes missed detections and P1 quality-rejected images",
L000382:               "field_accuracy_claim": False, "worker_execution_verified": False,
L000383:               "label_independence_verified": False, "timeline_execution_verified": False,
L000384:               "manifest": manifest, "candidate": metrics_by_activity(predictions, manifest),
L000385:               "comparison": None}
L000386:     if baseline_predictions_path:
L000387:         baseline_manifest = _manifest(baseline_manifest_path, truth_path)
L000388:         for field in FROZEN_FIELDS:
L000389:             _require(_same_json(baseline_manifest[field], manifest[field]),
L000390:                      "no-downgrade audit rejected changed " + field)
L000391:         _require(_same_json({k: v for k, v in baseline_manifest.items() if k != "worker_sha256"},
L000392:                             {k: v for k, v in manifest.items() if k != "worker_sha256"}),
L000393:                  "no-downgrade audit rejected changed additional dataset metadata")
L000394:         baseline = _rows(baseline_predictions_path)
L000395:         _validate_predictions(baseline, truth, baseline_manifest)
L000396:         for key in predictions:
L000397:             _require(predictions[key]["input_sha256"] == baseline[key]["input_sha256"],
L000398:                      "baseline/candidate event input changed: " + repr(key))
L000399:         previous = metrics_by_activity(baseline, baseline_manifest)
L000400:         current = report["candidate"]
L000401:         checks = []
L000402:         rules = (
L000403:                 ("counts", "enrolled_wrong_associations", "nonincrease"),
L000404:                 ("counts", "unknown_false_registered_accepts", "nonincrease"),
L000405:                 ("anonymous_pairs", "false_merge_pairs", "nonincrease"),
L000406:                 ("anonymous_pairs", "false_split_pairs", "nonincrease"),
L000407:                 ("counts", "enrolled_correct_accepts", "nondecrease"),
L000408:                 ("counts", "anonymous_confirmed_events", "nondecrease"))
L000409:         for scope in [None] + sorted(previous["by_activity"]):
L000410:             old_metrics = previous if scope is None else previous["by_activity"][scope]
L000411:             new_metrics = current if scope is None else current["by_activity"][scope]
L000412:             for group, field, direction in rules:
L000413:                 old, new = old_metrics[group][field], new_metrics[group][field]
L000414:                 passed = new <= old if direction == "nonincrease" else new >= old
L000415:                 checks.append({"activity_id": scope, "metric": field, "baseline": old, "candidate": new,
L000416:                                "requirement": direction, "passed": passed})
L000417:         report["baseline"] = previous
L000418:         report["comparison"] = {"passed": all(check["passed"] for check in checks), "checks": checks,
L000419:                                 "baseline_worker_sha256": baseline_manifest["worker_sha256"],
L000420:                                 "candidate_worker_sha256": manifest["worker_sha256"],
L000421:                                 "hold_count_delta": current["statuses"].get("HOLD", 0) - previous["statuses"].get("HOLD", 0),
L000422:                                 "confirmed_coverage_delta": current["rates"]["confirmed_coverage"] - previous["rates"]["confirmed_coverage"]}
L000423:     return report
L000424: 
L000425: 
L000426: def main():
L000427:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
L000428:     parser.add_argument("--truth", type=Path, required=True)
L000429:     parser.add_argument("--predictions", type=Path, required=True)
L000430:     parser.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, required=True)
L000431:     parser.add_argument("--baseline-predictions", type=Path)
L000432:     parser.add_argument("--baseline-manifest", type=Path)
L000433:     parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
L000434:     args = parser.parse_args()
L000435:     try:
L000436:         _require(not args.output.exists(), "fresh output file required")
L000437:         report = evaluate_files(args.truth, args.predictions, args.manifest,
L000438:                                 baseline_predictions_path=args.baseline_predictions,
L000439:                                 baseline_manifest_path=args.baseline_manifest)
L000440:         args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
L000441:         with args.output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
L000442:             json.dump(report, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
L000443:             stream.write("\n")
L000444:         passed = report["comparison"] is None or report["comparison"]["passed"]
L000445:         print(json.dumps({"report": str(args.output), "evidence_kind": report["evidence_kind"],
L000446:                           "comparison_passed": None if report["comparison"] is None else passed}))
L000447:         return 0 if passed else 1
L000448:     except (EvaluationError, OSError) as exc:
L000449:         print(json.dumps({"error": str(exc)}, ensure_ascii=False), file=sys.stderr)
L000450:         return 2
L000451: 
L000452: 
L000453: if __name__ == "__main__":
L000454:     raise SystemExit(main())

L000001: """Read-only loopback viewer. No backend proxy, credentials or database access."""
L000002: import argparse

L000004: from pathlib import Path
L000005: 
L000006: BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
L000007: ALLOWED = {'index.html', 'style.css', 'viewer.mjs', 'trace.mjs', 'sample.json'}
L000008: 
L000009: class Handler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
L000010:     def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
L000011:         super().__init__(*args, directory=str(BASE), **kwargs)
L000012:     def do_GET(self):
L000013:         path = self.path.split('?', 1)[0]
L000014:         name = 'index.html' if path == '/' else path.removeprefix('/')
L000015:         if name not in ALLOWED:
L000016:             self.send_error(404)
L000017:             return
L000018:         self.path = '/' + name
L000019:         super().do_GET()
L000020:     def do_HEAD(self):
L000021:         self.send_error(405)
L000022:     def end_headers(self):
L000023:         self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
L000024:         self.send_header('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff')
L000025:         self.send_header('Content-Security-Policy', "default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'")
L000026:         super().end_headers()
L000027:     def guess_type(self, path):
L000028:         if path.endswith('.mjs'):
L000029:             return 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8'
L000030:         return super().guess_type(path)
L000031: 
L000032: if __name__ == '__main__':
L000033:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
L000034:     parser.add_argument('--port', type=int, default=8793)
L000035:     args = parser.parse_args()
L000036:     with http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', args.port), Handler) as server:
L000037:         print(f'Point viewer: http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/', flush=True)
L000038:         server.serve_forever()

L000001: const fail = message => { throw new Error(message); };
L000002: const key = (source, id) => JSON.stringify([source, id]);
L000003: const text = (value, name) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0 ? value : fail(`${name} 缺失`);
L000004: const point = value => Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 3 && value.every(Number.isFinite);
L000005: 
L000006: export function prepareTrace(value) {
L000007:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || value.ok === false) fail('需要成功的 point_trace 查询结果');
L000008:   const trace = value.point_trace ?? value;
L000009:   text(trace.target_id, 'target_id');
L000010:   text(trace.coordinate_frame, 'coordinate_frame');
L000011:   if (trace.drawing_mode !== 'CAMERA_POINT_CONNECTIONS') fail('结果缺少点位连接合同，请使用新版 worker');
L000012:   if (!Number.isSafeInteger(trace.version) || trace.version < 1) fail('轨迹版本无效');
L000013:   if (!Array.isArray(trace.observations) || !Array.isArray(trace.connections)) fail('经过点位或连接列表无效');
L000014:   if (trace.observations.length > 50000 || trace.connections.length > 50000) fail('单次查看最多 50000 条，请缩小查询结果');
L000015:   const observations = new Map();
L000016:   for (const o of trace.observations) {
L000017:     const id = key(text(o.source_id, 'source_id'), text(o.observation_id, 'observation_id'));
L000018:     if (observations.has(id)) fail('存在重复的来源/观测键');
L000019:     text(o.camera_id, 'camera_id');
L000020:     if (o.status !== 'OBSERVED') fail('查看结果含非确认经过记录');
L000021:     if (!Number.isSafeInteger(o.captured_at_unix_ms) || Math.abs(o.captured_at_unix_ms) > 8640000000000000 ||
L000022:         !Number.isSafeInteger(o.clock_uncertainty_ms) || o.clock_uncertainty_ms < 0)
L000023:       fail('时间超出浏览器可精确显示范围');
L000024:     if (!Array.isArray(o.position_candidates) || !o.position_candidates.every(p => point(p.local_xyz))) fail('点位坐标无效');
L000025:     observations.set(id, o);
L000026:   }
L000027:   const lines = trace.connections.map((c, index) => {
L000028:     const from = observations.get(key(c.from_source_id, c.from_observation_id));
L000029:     const to = observations.get(key(c.to_source_id, c.to_observation_id));
L000030:     if (!from || !to || c.from_camera_id !== from.camera_id || c.to_camera_id !== to.camera_id || from.camera_id === to.camera_id)
L000031:       fail('连接端点与经过记录不一致');
L000032:     if (!['ORDERED', 'UNCERTAIN_CLOCK_ORDER'].includes(c.order_status) ||
L000033:         !['DRAWABLE', 'UNRESOLVED_POSITION', 'SESSION_BREAK'].includes(c.drawing_status) ||
L000034:         c.physical_path_observed !== false || c.meaning !== 'DIRECT_CAMERA_POINT_CONNECTION') fail('连接语义无效');
L000035:     if (!Array.isArray(c.coordinates)) fail('连接坐标无效');
L000036:     if (c.drawing_status === 'DRAWABLE') {
L000037:       if (c.coordinates.length !== 2 || !c.coordinates.every(point) ||
L000038:           from.position_status !== 'BOUND_MARKER' || to.position_status !== 'BOUND_MARKER' ||
L000039:           from.position_candidates.length !== 1 || to.position_candidates.length !== 1 ||
L000040:           c.coordinates.some((p, i) => p.some((v, axis) => v !== [from, to][i].position_candidates[0].local_xyz[axis])))
L000041:         fail('可绘制连接必须使用两个唯一的原始点位');
L000042:     } else if (c.coordinates.length !== 0) fail('未确定的连接不能带绘制坐标');
L000043:     return {...c, from, to, index};
L000044:   });
L000045:   return {trace, activityId: value.activity_id ?? null, evidenceKind: value.evidence_kind ?? null,
L000046:     observations: [...observations.values()], lines,
L000047:     freshness: trace.freshness?.status ?? value.freshness?.status ?? 'UNSPECIFIED',
L000048:     drawable: lines.filter(c => c.drawing_status === 'DRAWABLE')};
L000049: }
L000050: 
L000051: export function projection(points, axes, width = 920, height = 560) {
L000052:   if (!points.length) return () => [width / 2, height / 2];
L000053:   const unit = Math.max(1, ...points.map(p => Math.max(Math.abs(p[axes[0]]), Math.abs(p[axes[1]]))));
L000054:   const xs = points.map(p => p[axes[0]] / unit), ys = points.map(p => p[axes[1]] / unit);
L000055:   const minX = Math.min(...xs), maxX = Math.max(...xs), minY = Math.min(...ys), maxY = Math.max(...ys);
L000056:   const scale = Math.min((width - 140) / Math.max(maxX - minX, 1e-12), (height - 140) / Math.max(maxY - minY, 1e-12));
L000057:   return p => [width / 2 + (p[axes[0]] / unit - (minX / 2 + maxX / 2)) * scale,
L000058:     height / 2 - (p[axes[1]] / unit - (minY / 2 + maxY / 2)) * scale];
L000059: }
L000060: 
L000061: export function connectionGroups(lines) {
L000062:   const groups = new Map();
L000063:   for (const line of lines) {
L000064:     // Include full coordinates and camera IDs: separate camera pairs or
L000065:     // positions must not be merged just because a 2D projection overlaps.
L000066:     const ends = [JSON.stringify([line.from_camera_id, line.coordinates[0]]),
L000067:       JSON.stringify([line.to_camera_id, line.coordinates[1]])].sort();
L000068:     const groupKey = JSON.stringify(ends);
L000069:     const found = groups.get(groupKey);
L000070:     if (found) found.records.push(line);
L000071:     else groups.set(groupKey, {...line, records:[line]});
L000072:   }
L000073:   return [...groups.values()];
L000074: }
L000075: 
L000076: export function connectionDirections(group, selectedIndex = null) {
L000077:   const selected = group.records.find(record => record.index === selectedIndex);
L000078:   const records = selected ? [selected] : group.records;
L000079:   const status = items => items.length ? (items.every(record => record.order_status === 'ORDERED')
L000080:     ? 'ORDERED' : 'UNCERTAIN_CLOCK_ORDER') : null;
L000081:   return {selected, records,
L000082:     forward:status(records.filter(record=>record.from_camera_id===group.from_camera_id)),
L000083:     reverse:status(records.filter(record=>record.from_camera_id===group.to_camera_id))};
L000084: }
